unstop-1798568.body:
About MonkyVision 
 Monkyvision Creative Solutions is a high-velocity, system-led agency engineering the future of digital content strategy and storytelling. We don’t just deliver creative services—we build high-performance growth engines for global brands. By fusing cutting-edge design psychology, premium animation pipelines, and advanced workflow automations, we translate bold creative visions into measurable, international market impact.
 Our culture entirely rejects traditional corporate bureaucracy in favor of an elite sports-team mindset . We operate with radical candor, champion absolute intellectual independence, and demand extreme ownership from every player on our roster. At Monkyvision, we continuously upskill, integrate next-generation tools, and eliminate friction to maintain an uncompromising velocity. We don't just log hours; we build wonders. 
 Role Overview: 
 This isn’t just about editing — it’s about shaping stories with confidence and cutting‑edge tools. We’re seeking a full‑time Video Editor who thrives in a startup environment, embraces AI‑driven content creation , and can deliver independently while collaborating seamlessly with the team. You’ll work across long‑form and short‑form content, with a mandatory focus on motion graphic design and YouTube‑optimized storytelling .
 Key Responsibilities :
 Motion Graphics & Animation : Create dynamic animations, transitions, and 3D camera work to elevate projects.
 AI Content Creation : Apply trending AI platforms for editing, captioning, ideation, and visual generation.
 YouTube Content Expertise : Tailor edits for YouTube with optimized formats, thumbnails, hooks, and retention‑driven pacing.
 Video Editing & Production : Edit and produce long‑form and short‑form content with strong narrative flow, pacing, and visual polish.
 Cross‑Platform Adaptation : Adapt content for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other digital platforms.
 Creative Experimentation : Explore new editing styles, AI prompts, and storytelling techniques to keep content fresh.
 Workflow & Asset Management : Organize video assets, maintain brand consistency, and deliver on deadlines.
 Collaboration : Work closely with designers, marketers, and content strategists to align video outputs with campaign goals.
 Quality Assurance : Review and refine edits to ensure technical accuracy, smooth transitions, and brand consistency.
 Trend Monitoring : Stay updated on emerging video trends, AI tools, and audience preferences.
 Storyboarding : Collaborate on pre‑production planning, translating concepts into clear visual sequences.
 Performance Insights : Track video engagement metrics and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
 Experience & Skills: 
 Mandatory expertise in motion graphics and animation techniques.
 Mandatory experience in YouTube content workflows (SEO, thumbnails, retention strategies, pacing).
 2–3 years of proven experience in Motion Graphic & video editing across long‑form and short‑form formats.
 Prior experience working with a digital marketing agency or creative agency environment.
 Proficiency in After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar.
 Hands‑on exposure to AI tools (RunwayML, ChatGPT, MidJourney, or equivalents).
 Understanding of AI prompts for video/image generation.
 International project exposure is a plus.
 Mindset & Creativity: 
 Extreme Ownership: You don't wait for hand-holding. You take a project, map out the checklists independently, and drive it to the finish line.
 Thick Skin & Radical Candor: You welcome direct, honest feedback and give it back with respect. We don't hide behind polite corporate fluff; we focus on performance and growth.
 Output-Driven Mindset: You understand that value is measured by the quality and velocity of what you ship, not just by the hours you sit at your desk.
 Unfettered Thinking: You use advanced tools and AI to scale your execution speed, but you never outsource your critical thinking or stop mastering your core craft.
 Storytelling Passion : Strong instinct for narrative and audience engagement.
 Trend Awareness : Ability to spot and leverage emerging tools and styles.
 Additional Expectations: 
 Portfolio or samples of past work.
 Ability to deliver projects under tight timelines with clear communication.
 Benefits & Perks: 
 Full‑Time Stability : Secure role with consistent growth opportunities.
 Clear Growth Path : Transparent career progression with equal opportunities.
 Creative Freedom : Experiment with AI‑driven workflows and innovative techniques.
 Open‑Door Policy : Direct access to leadership and open communication culture.
 Skill Growth : Exposure to international projects, emerging tools, and continuous learning.
 Impactful Work : Shape content that drives brand storytelling and audience engagement.
 Inclusive Culture : Collaborative, diverse, and supportive environment.
 Closing: 
 We do not run a slow, padded corporate environment. We operate like a championship team chasing elite velocity

unstop-1798244.body:
About TorqWars: 
 TorqWars is building India's competitive RC racing. We are a sports-entertainment business running on three engines: experience-led arenas with timed racing, a league, and a D2C store for RC cars and parts. Our first arena opens soon in Bandra, Mumbai, and we are backed by The Foundery. Our mission is to make battling with machines a real sport. You will work directly with the founders and own how your function is built from the ground up.
 Role overview: 
 You will own the TorqWars player community and our events: tournaments, leagues, racing events and brand activations. You will grow a community of players who come back, compete and bring their friends, and turn our events into a format we can run across every arena. In the first few months you will run the events and community channels yourself, and build the team as both grow.
 Key responsibilities: Community 
 Build and manage the player community: how people discover us, sign up, play, return and refer others.
 Run community channels such as WhatsApp groups, Instagram and Discord.
 Build ambassador, creator, campus and hobby-club programmes.
 Create community content with the creative team: player stories, event recaps, creator features, leaderboards and rivalries.
 Key responsibilities: Events 
 Design event and tournament formats: rules, heats, scoring and run of show.
 Manage production: staging, timing, sound, lights and the safety plan.
 Source and brief vendors and event crew, and lead on the day.
 Run a post-event review after every event and apply the learnings to the next one.
 KPIs: 
 Active returning players, new players per event, organic sign-ups without paid ads, events delivered on time and safely, and participant and spectator feedback.
 Requirements: 
 Experience across community management, field or experiential marketing, and live events. Senior candidates are welcome, and so are candidates with 3–5 years who have built and grown a community themselves.
 Proof of retention: repeat attendance, retention or referral numbers, not just reach or impressions.
 Has owned events or event IPs end to end: budget, vendors, run of show and on-ground management.
 Has built a programme or format that kept running after you moved on.
 Willing to be on the ground at events, including evenings and weekends.
 Good to have: 
 Motorsport, RC, karting, gaming or esports. Campus and youth marketing. Sports or brand partnerships. Startup or founder experience.
 How we assess: 
 A quick AI voice interview with your camera on (about 20 minutes, five main questions): a community you built, an event that broke on the day and what you changed, a TorqWars race-night scenario to plan out loud, and what your last manager would say about you. We do not expect you to know RC cars; we will teach you the sport. We speak to references before any offer.
 Your first 90 days: 
 The first race format defined and run end to end, the first ambassadors and community channels active, and a returning-player baseline we track every week.
 What we offer: 
 Ownership of community and events from day one, 0.1–0.5% ESOPs (vesting as set out in the offer letter), direct work with the founders, and the chance to build a new sport in India.
 Hiring process: 
 A short AI interview, a call with a founder, a short assignment for shortlisted candidates, an in-person meeting in Mumbai with reference checks, a final conversation with our co-founder, and an offer within 2 weeks of the first call.
 When you apply, share: 
 A community you built where people came back, with the repeat numbers.
 An event you owned end to end, and your role in it.
 Current and expected CTC, and notice period.

unstop-1794098.body:
Salary: ₹60,000 per month fixed + up to ₹1,50,000 commission (₹60,000–₹2,10,000 per month total). Salary is paid on the 7th of each month. 
 MCA Sales Representative – Growpath Capital 
 Shift: Fixed Night Shift, Monday to Saturday, 12:30 AM – 8:30 AM IST (North American business hours)
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Work Mode: Remote (Work From Home)
 About Us 
 Growpath Capital is an established firm that helps small and mid-sized businesses in the US and Canada get the business funding they need to grow, mainly through merchant cash advance (MCA) funding. Our sales team works fully remotely from India. We are growing our outbound team and want experienced MCA sellers who enjoy making calls and closing deals.
 What Is An MCA? 
 A merchant cash advance (MCA) is fast funding for small businesses. The funder buys a share of the business's future sales and pays a lump sum upfront, and the business repays it from its sales, daily or weekly. Funding usually arrives within 24 to 72 hours.
 Clients include restaurants, trucking and transportation companies, construction and skilled trades, retail shops, medical and dental clinics, salons, auto shops, e-commerce sellers, and more.
 As a representative, you qualify the business owner and collect the short application and 3 to 6 months of bank statements. Growpath Capital's funders review the file and fund the deal.
 What You Will Do 
 Make outbound calls every day to small business owners in the US and Canada.
 Explain MCA funding options in simple words.
 Qualify each business based on revenue, time in business, current debt, and funding needs.
 Collect documents, present the approved offer, and close the deal.
 Keep clean notes on every call in our CRM and follow up on time.
 Achieve daily call and monthly funding targets.
 As you grow, build, coach, and lead your own team of representatives.
 We're hiring experienced MCA and B2B finance sales professionals, not freshers.
 Must-Haves 
 B2B MCA or working-capital sales experience, ideally with international clients. Please share your numbers.
 Strong outbound calling experience with business owners.
 Fluency in English and Hindi.
 Your own laptop with a good camera and a noise-cancelling headset.
 Reliable Wi-Fi and power backup (UPS or inverter).
 A quiet space to work from.
 Nice To Have 
 Experience selling to US or Canadian business owners.
 Experience hiring, training, or managing a sales team.
 Knowledge of MCA, lines of credit, equipment finance, or invoice finance.
 Comfort with CRM tools and dialers.
 What We Offer 
 Earning Potential: Earn up to ₹2,10,000 a month, comprising a ₹60,000 monthly salary plus up to ₹1,50,000 a month in commission (up to ₹15,000 per funded sale). Commission is paid on every deal from the start.
 Sales Manager Incentives: As a Sales Manager, you will lead and manage your own team of sales representatives and earn extra incentives on your team's funded sales, in addition to your own salary and commission. Your salary is never tied to your team's targets; it depends only on your own sales.
 Extra bonuses when you hit targets.
 A clear path to leading your own team.
 Product training and a sales playbook before you start.
 Fully remote work from home.
 How To Apply 
 Apply on Unstop. Shortlisted candidates will have a short first-round video interview in English and Hindi.

unstop-1793604.body:
About Chauffit: 
 Chauffit is a safety-first, on-demand driver service for people who own a car but can't always, or shouldn't, drive it themselves. Customers book a professionally verified and assessed driver within minutes, for their own car, and pay only for the trip. 
 We are building the most trusted way to get your car driven, starting with Gurugram, where we launch in November 2026. Our apps are live, and we are a small, ambitious team focused on safety, reliability and an exceptional customer experience. 
 About the Role: 
 As our External Operations Associate, you will own everything that happens on the ground. You will build our driver and biker supply, set up and manage the partners we depend on, and open new areas and channels as we grow across Gurugram. 
 This is a field role that combines operations and business development. Some days you will be onboarding drivers; other days you will be pitching a club, a bar or a residents' association. In the early weeks after launch you will also be the first responder when a trip needs urgent help. 
 Location: Gurugram (field-based, on-ground) 
 Type: Full-time 
 Salary: ₹3.6 - 4.2 LPA  
 Start date: 16 November 2026 
 What Success Looks Like: 
 First 30 days: Run a repeatable driver and biker onboarding process, from sourcing to verification to training, and have our core vendors (training, uniforms) delivering on time 
 First 60 days: Bring live partnerships with clubs, bars and residential societies that send us bookings, each tracked from first contact to first trip 
 First 90 days: Own the playbook for opening a new area: supply, partners and on-ground readiness, with the numbers to show it works 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Driver and biker onboarding 
 Source drivers and bikers through referrals, local networks, job boards and on-ground drives 
 Run document collection, background verification and assessment for every partner 
 Coordinate training and uniforms so each partner is road-ready on day one 
 Keep the supply pipeline and partner records current 
 Vendor and partner management 
 Manage our third-party partners, including the driving school that trains our drivers and the uniform supplier 
 Negotiate terms, track deliveries and fix issues before they reach customers 
 Business development and expansion 
 Pitch and close partnerships with clubs, bars, residents' welfare associations (RWAs) and other local channels 
 Follow up on leads and keep a partner tracker with status and next steps 
 Scout new areas and prepare supply and partners before each one goes live 
 On-ground support 
 Handle SOS and urgent trip issues in the early launch phase, and escalate to the founders when needed 
 Oversee the kiosk during night operations, ensuring it is staffed, operational and running smoothly 
 Support launch events, society activations and kiosks with the marketing team 
 Share a weekly update on supply, partners and issues, with what to fix next 
 Requirements: 
 1–3 years in field operations, supply onboarding, business development or partnerships (strong freshers with on-ground experience are welcome) 
 Comfortable spending most of the day in the field across Gurugram, including some evenings and weekends around launch 
 Confident in Hindi and English, able to talk with drivers, vendors and venue managers alike 
 Organised with trackers in Google Sheets/Excel, and quick to follow up 
 Calm and practical under pressure, with high ownership 
 Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence 
 Good to Have: 
 Experience in mobility, ride-hailing, logistics or quick commerce operations (driver or delivery partner onboarding) 
 An existing network of drivers, clubs, bars or RWAs in Gurugram 
 Experience negotiating with vendors 
 What We Offer: 
 Build Chauffit's on-ground operations from launch day, working directly with the founders 
 Real ownership: your playbook becomes how we open every new area 
 A fast learning curve across operations, partnerships and growth 
 An open culture where your ideas from the field shape the product 
 A clear path to lead an operations team as we expand 
 Chauffit is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, caste, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age or background. All applications are evaluated solely on merit.

About Rupeek 
 Rupeek, established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, stands as India's leading asset-backed digital lending fintech platform. Committed to making credit accessible to Indians in a fair and convenient manner, Rupeek pioneers innovative financial products focused on monetizing India's $2 trillion gold market. Leveraging state-of-the-art technology and an automated asset-light supply chain, Rupeek is transforming the gold loan disbursal landscape across 40+ cities in India. With a customer base exceeding 5,00,000+, the company's strategic partnerships with top banks and financial institutions underscore its commitment to building gold-backed assets through low-risk, low-touch, and friction-free processes. 
 Rupeek's impressive journey is supported by key investors such as Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Bertelsmann, and GGV Capital. In Apr 2024, Rupeek turned profitable and raised $25M in equity capital from Manipal Group and Elevation Capital to fund its next phase of growth. Join us in redefining the future of finance through innovation, technology, and a commitment to financial inclusivity. 
 You will be trained on 
 Gold Appraisal 
 Lead generation 
 Customer relationship management 
 Loan Processing 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 To ensure 100% right valuation – capturing right caratage, proper stone deduction, avoid/prevent spurious/unacceptable ornaments. 
 Adhering to high ethical standards and complying with all the laid down processes / policies of Rupeek – KYC adherence. Verify customers' KYC & complete online registration. 
 Coordinate with the Manager and stakeholders for loan approval. 
 Ensure to bring in new customers and maintain good relationships with existing customers for generating renewal & referral business. 
 Resolve all customer doubts and questions while processing the loan. 
 Participate in business development activities to improve the brand visibility of Rupeek Gold Loan in the catchment areas and to generate leads of prospective customers. 
 Persona 
 Freshers or candidates with up to 12 months of experience in any field 
 Any Degree 
 Up to 27 years of age 
 Excellent communication skills in the local language and elementary English 
 Male candidates must have a 2 wheeler and Driving License within 60 days of joining Rupeek. Driving License is not mandatory for women candidates. 
 Salary: ₹12,600 per month (₹10,600 fixed component + ₹2,000 monthly guaranteed bonus) with eligibility to earn an additional ₹2,000 in contests.

unstop-1794181.body:
Nearestate is hiring for SEO Intern (Digital Marketing) 
 About the Company 
 Nearestate is a Hyderabad-based PropTech marketplace built around RealView360®, an immersive virtual-tour experience that helps people explore and discover properties online. The team combines real estate, content, marketing, and technology to make property search more engaging and useful. As an SEO Intern, you will contribute to the visibility and growth of the company’s digital products while learning from experienced marketing professionals. You will be guided by the SEO Manager throughout the internship.
 Responsibilities 
 Conduct keyword research, organize search intent, and identify content opportunities across B2B, eCommerce, and property-related topics.
 Support on-page optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and image alt text.
 Research, outline, and draft blogs, comparison pages, and landing-page content that is useful to readers and optimized for search.
 Assist with technical SEO checks for broken links, duplicate content, crawl issues, page speed, and schema markup.
 Analyze competitor rankings, content, and backlink profiles, and summarize opportunities for the team.
 Track organic traffic, rankings, and conversions using Google Analytics and Google Search Console, and help prepare performance reports.
 Support outreach and link-building research while monitoring algorithm updates and SEO best practices under the guidance of the SEO Manager.
 Requirements 
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, Information Technology, or a related field.
 No prior professional experience is required; relevant coursework, a personal blog, or a website is a plus.
 Basic understanding of crawling, indexing, ranking, keyword research, and on-page SEO.
 Familiarity with spreadsheets, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, CMS platforms, or tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog is helpful.
 Strong writing, analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, along with a willingness to learn quickly.
 Basic HTML/CSS knowledge is an advantage.
 This is a paid, full-time, in-office internship based in Hyderabad for 3 months, with a stipend of ₹10,000–₹12,000 per month. The intern will receive direct guidance from the SEO Manager, mentorship, hands-on exposure to live SEO campaigns and professional tools, a certificate, and a letter of recommendation for strong performance. High-performing interns may also be considered for a full-time opportunity.

 This is a sales role. Not a generalist business internship. 
 What you will do 
 Prospect (35%): Build target lists of mid-market and enterprise companies across India, Mexico, Singapore, and new markets as we expand. Find the procurement, finance, and operations decision-makers, and research their spend categories and buying triggers.
 Outbound (30%): Make 40 to 60 calls a day, plus email and LinkedIn sequences. Get past gatekeepers, start conversations, and book meetings.
 Qualify and demo (20%): Run discovery calls to understand how the buyer purchases today, map stakeholders, and show Procupy against their workflow. Team up with founders on larger deals.
 Close and follow up (10%): Send proposals, chase decisions, negotiate within guardrails, and get signatures. Keep the CRM honest.
 Learn the market (5%): Feed competitor intel, objections, and buyer language back into our scripts and ICP.
 What success looks like 
 300 to 400 outbound touches per week
 8 to 12 qualified meetings booked per month
 1 to 3 closed deals per month after a 30-day ramp, with founder support
 100% pipeline honesty. You can explain your numbers without hiding behind "the lead was bad"
 Who you are 
 Final-year student or recent graduate. BBA, B.Com, B.Tech, MBA, or anything else if you can sell.
 0 to 1 year of experience. A prior sales, BD, or customer-facing internship is a plus, not a requirement.
 Fluent in English and Hindi. Spanish is a strong bonus for our Mexico market.
 Comfortable with cold calls. Not "willing to try." Comfortable.
 Organised, competitive, and self-directed. You do not need someone to tell you to follow up.
 Basic Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HubSpot or Zoho is a bonus.
 Available full-time for at least 3 months.
 What you get 
 ₹10,000 to ₹25,000 per month stipend. The top of the band is for candidates with prior outbound or SaaS sales experience.
 20% sales incentive on every deal you close, paid on realisation.
 Direct mentorship from the founders. You will see how a B2B SaaS company actually sells.
 Real ownership from week one: your name on deals, your pipeline, your numbers.
 Stipend review at 3 months based on performance.
 Certificate and letter of recommendation on completion.
 PPO for top performers.
 Selection process 
 Application, then a 20-minute call, then a mock cold call or discovery role-play, then an offer.
 In your application, tell us in 3 to 4 lines about a time you sold or persuaded someone, and why B2B sales at an early-stage startup.

unstop-1792842.body:
Role: 
 Flirk Campus Crew is a 14-week marketing internship ( 12 November 2026 to 15 February 2027 ) around the launch of Flirk , a new personality-first dating & social app for 18+, where you meet people through personality, not photos. You work directly with the founder (IIM Lucknow; ex-Spotify, ex-Myntra).
 You make Flirk a part of your campus: you bring in the first users, tell us what students actually think, and help design and run the campaigns that take Flirk from launch day (20 November) to Valentine’s Week.
 Two tracks, you do both:
 Creator : 1. You post about Flirk in your own voice - reels, stories, memes on your social; 2. You come up with marketing & brand-related ideas to grow Flirk's user base. 
 Connector : you open doors to societies, fests, group chats and hangouts on your campus
 Part-time and flexible: ~10 hours a week, online (virtual) . Your exam weeks are protected -  tell us the dates and we plan around them.
 Responsibilities: 
 Pre-launch: get as many pre-sign-ups as you can from everyone you know who is 18+ and single — classmates, friends, the group chats, council groups, college hangouts — through your personal tracked pre-signup website link, and run a short anonymous survey on how dating actually works on your campus.
 Post-launch growth: once the app is live on the Play Store and App Store, convert those sign-ups into installs, bring in new users, and ideate on marketing and content ideas for growing the user base — the best ones get implemented.
 Christmas and New Year: help conceive and run a phased marketing campaign, on campus and online through the last 3 weeks of December. Ideate & work on Christmas Merchandise.
 Valentine’s Week: Ideate & work on Flirk's Valentine's day campaign/event and run it on campus from 7 to 14 February.
 Throughout: a weekly check-in with the founder; a weekly campus pulse (what people say about Flirk, what confuses them, what breaks, what they like); Create & post two pieces of content around Flirk per week; App improvement suggestions & new ideas for growth.
 Requirements: 
 18 years of age or older, currently enrolled at a degree college in Mumbai (BMM, BMS, B.Des, B.A., B.E., BBA, B.Tech etc)
 Second or third year of a four-year degree, or second year of a three-year degree course (final-year students in a three-year degree may apply if they can commit time till 15th February; first-years cannot apply).
 Genuinely interested in marketing - you want a marketing experience, not just a certificate.
 Creative thinker and already making content : a public Instagram profile is required.
 A self-starter who begins things without being told and learns fast.
 Comfortable communicating in English ; Is social & has a good connect on campus 
 Single. Not a joke - the role needs you to think like Flirk’s user, which is hard to fake when you're in a relationship.
 Can commit 10 hrs a week till 15 February, reachable on WhatsApp, residing in Mumbai. 
 No prior work experience needed.
 Need to have a personal laptop.
 What You Get
 Internship Stipend
 Experience Certificate
 Letter of Recommendation (top-performers only)
 Flirk merchandise / goodies
 Hands-on experience in Marketing
 Work with the Founder directly

About ROI Boosters 
 ROI Boosters is a Gurugram-based paid media agency focused on delivering measurable business growth through performance marketing. Our team of 25 professionals manages advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Bing for brands across the US, Europe, and the UAE.
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Business Development Intern to help identify potential clients, initiate conversations, and support our client acquisition efforts.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead Generation: Research brands investing $3,000 or more per month in paid advertising and identify potential business opportunities.
 Prospect Research: Identify key decision-makers, including founders and marketing heads, within target companies.
 Outreach & Follow-ups: Draft personalised emails and LinkedIn messages and follow up with prospects systematically.
 Proposal Writing: Prepare proposals for relevant projects on platforms such as Upwork and Fiverr.
 Sales Support: Assist with discovery call preparation, research, meeting notes, and follow-up communication.
 Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of leads, outreach activities, responses, and follow-up schedules.
 Daily Reporting: Submit concise end-of-day reports through Slack, highlighting completed tasks, progress, and pending activities.
 Continuous Improvement: Incorporate feedback to improve outreach quality, personalisation, and overall business development performance.
 Eligibility Criteria: 
 Strong written English and the ability to communicate professionally.
 High reliability, punctuality, and consistency in completing assigned tasks.
 Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions accurately.
 Willingness to learn sales outreach, lead generation, and client acquisition.
 Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
 Must have a laptop and a stable internet connection.
 Must be available Monday to Saturday, from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, for a minimum of three months.
 Freshers are welcome to apply. Prior experience in sales, freelancing, social media, content writing, or business development is an advantage but not mandatory.
 What We Offer: 
 Hands-on training in agency business development and client acquisition.
 Exposure to international brands and performance marketing across five major advertising platforms.
 Regular feedback and guidance to help improve research, writing, and sales skills.
 Practical experience with tools such as ClickUp and Slack.
 Opportunity to progress into a Business Development Executive role based on performance.
 Internship completion certificate and recommendation upon successful completion of the internship.
 All outreach messages and proposals will be reviewed, with regular feedback provided to support learning and improvement.
 There will initially be a paid trial period (15 working days with compensation of ₹5,000), which will be used to evaluate consistency, communication, attention to detail, and ability to execute assigned tasks.
 Selection Process: 
 Email Task & HR Interview: Complete a short email-writing task, followed by a 35-minute video interview with HR. Candidates must join using a laptop, keep their camera on, and be prepared to share their screen.
 Practical Assignment: Complete a 48-hour business development assignment requiring approximately three hours of work in total.
 CEO Interview: Attend a 30-minute video interview with the CEO, including a mock sales call.

unstop-1788791.body:
About Crea8 
 "Will this product work for me?" sounds like a simple question. The skincare industry has spent decades making sure it isn’t. Most skincare content online is confusing, biased, or brand-driven. We think that's broken.
 Crea8 is a skincare personalisation engine that helps D2C brands guide every user to the right products, based on what’s inside them. It combines skin profiling, ingredient-level formulation analysis, and explainable AI to deliver personalised recommendations that build trust, improve conversion, and increase customer lifetime value.
 Users like what we’ve built. Brands are only beginning to discover us. Until we get in front of them, Crea8 is a product people like, not a business. Marketing must bridge that gap by showing brands how effective personalisation can improve conversion and engagement.
 If you want a startup line for your CV, this is not the place. If you want to build something from scratch next to the founder, keep reading.
 What you’ll accomplish 
 Outbound: Generate discovery calls with skincare brands through email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels using existing content automation systems.
 Inbound: Build Crea8’s visibility and credibility through content, press, and other channels that encourage brands to reach out to us.
Partnerships and Relationships: Build relationships with people at and around target brands, create opportunities for introductions, and turn these connections into conversations.
 Build a repeatable marketing system with clear metrics, documented learnings, and evidence of what works.
 What a week can look like 
 Run email campaigns, manage the CRM pipeline, publish content, pitch relevant publications and creators, and test new channels.
 Track what generates business opportunities, build industry relationships, and show brands how Crea8 addresses their challenges.
 Who we are looking for 
 Strong communication skills matter.
 Should be comfortable writing persuasive messages, reaching out to people you don’t know, following up, and finding better ways to get a response.
 A willingness to question conventional marketing approaches, figure out what works for us, track results, and adjust when something isn’t working is equally important.
 While 1 to 2 years of experience in marketing, growth, or sales is preferred, it isn’t required. If you have less experience, show us something you’ve grown or built on your own.
 Employment: 
 Part-time from day one, with a three-month probation period.
 Stipend and Progression: 
 ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 per month for the first three months, increasing up to 100% per month from month four, on successful completion of probation. As Crea8 grows, my aim is to improve compensation based on business performance, your contribution, and what the company can sustainably support. The role includes an equity grant (0.5% - 3%), with the exact grant finalised before the offer letter. This allows you to participate in Crea8’s long-term growth.
 Location:  
Bengaluru preferred. Remote work available, with one in-person day per week for Bengaluru-based candidates.
 How we work 
 You work with me, not under me.
I value initiative and independent thinking, and I know you don’t like being micromanaged when you like your work.
 We care about outcomes, but we also understand that experiments won't always succeed. What matters is that we learn from the results, communicate openly, and make better decisions over time.
 Founder’s Note 
 I started Crea8 because people deserve better information about the skincare products they use. The industry relies heavily on marketing claims, leaving consumers unsure what to put on their skin. For brands, this means high acquisition costs, low conversion, and weak customer lifetime value.
 Our consumer product has attracted 20,000+ users, with 14% purchase conversion, average sessions exceeding 20 minutes, and 3.8 products per purchasing user. Now, we’re focused on turning that traction into a sustainable business by bringing our personalisation engine to skincare brands.
 I’ve taken the product as far as I can alone. You’ll help win our first brand customers and build a marketing system that eventually brings brands to us.
I’m looking for someone who wants to do more than execute tasks. You’ll have the freedom to challenge my thinking, experiment with new approaches, and build systems we can keep improving. 
Your work will directly shape how Crea8 grows.
 We’re still pre-revenue, which means there’s plenty to build and learn. If you’re ambitious about your own growth and want to take ownership of something from the early stages, I’d like to hear from you.
 Best,
Prabhav Agarwal
Founder, Crea8

 Time & Motion Study

 Break Down Manufacturing Activities Into Smaller Work Elements.

 Calculate Standard Time for Different Manufacturing Operations After Considering Performance Rating and Appropriate Allowances.

 Compare Actual Production Against Planned Production and Established Standards.

 Analyze Production Cycle Time and Material Movement Between Workstations.
 Identify Bottlenecks and Suggest Improvements in Workstation Layouts and Workflow.
 Assist in Developing Standard Operating Procedures (so Ps) and Standardized Work Instructions.

 Study Operator-Wise Allocation and Utilization of Working Hours.
 Monitor Machine Running Time, Idle Time and Downtime.
 Identify Imbalances in Workload Between Different Workstations.

 Bottleneck Operations.

 Apply Basic Lean Tools Such as 5 S, Process Mapping, 5 Why Analysis and Waste Identification.

 Support Implementation of Productivity Improvement Projects.

 Good at starting conversations? Let’s turn that into business.

 This is field sales and direct outreach

We’ll coordinate schedules and priorities in advance. The focus is on agreed commitments and follow-through, not being available 24/7 .

 Someone who’s hungry to learn, high on energy, comfortable, approaching new people, curious, and hearing “no” without taking it personally.

 Communicate clearly, listen well, and represent the company professionally.
 Stay organized and follow up without repeated reminders.
 Know the basics of spreadsheets and presentations; familiarity with CRM tools is a plus.
 Be comfortable using AI tools and learning new ways of working.
 Take ownership, welcome feedback, and adapt when startup priorities change.
 Commit to six months on-site in Hyderabad and travel locally using your own vehicle.
 What You’ll Gain 
 Direct founder mentorship, real client exposure, and hands-on learning across pitching, relationship building, CRM, and closing. We’ll agree on practical targets and review progress through qualified leads, meetings, follow-ups, conversions, and accurate records, not just calls made or cards collected.

amazon-10595295.body:
Amazon's Network Control Center (NCC) owns real-time observability, situational awareness, and coordinated intervention across the network to rapidly detect and eliminate issues before the customer journey is degraded.
The Real-Time Remedies Execution (RTRE) function within NCC acts as the centralized communications liaison between Amazon's Recovery teams, Business teams, and Amazon's customers. The mission is to help prevent contacts to Amazon by executing bulk actions on accounts and communications to customers impacted by large-scale issues. RTRE team is responsible for communicating to millions of D2customers each year across more than 20+ languages and owns all bulk actions such as large-scale physical and digital order refunds, cancellations, and more.
Do you want to join a team focused on critical communication and incident recovery, and play a role in the decision-making processes that restore/retain customer trust? Are you a passionate learner willing to relentlessly Deep Dive into data sets and partner with business analysts, advocates across leadership, and business teams? Do you thrive in a culture where Customer Obsession and the Bias For Action are highly valued?
As a Program Specialist, you will play a key role on the team by managing stakeholders on large-scale customer-impacting issues, owning relationships with partner teams, validating data, investigating customer issues, and driving the communications process from creation to execution. You will also contribute to NCC's broader mission of detecting and resolving incidents before customers are impacted, collaborating across multiple teams within the network. You will be detail oriented and results driven to ensure flawless communication execution as well as ensure the needs of both the customers and the business are addressed. Outside of these day-to-day duties, Program Specialists will own and have to work on process improvements.
Key job responsibilities
- Own and drive bulk recovery action for D2 customers, including data validation, stakeholder coordination, and flawless execution.
- Publish customer-facing mass communications, independently assessing situations and advocating for the most customer-centric path forward.
- Manage high-severity incidents by collaborating cross-functionally to mitigate risks to business, customer experience, and associate experience.
- Serve as the liaison between business analyst teams, product teams, and recovery stakeholders on complex issues requiring data assistance or tooling alignment.
- Execute high-impact mitigation actions using various tools while performing quality checks to ensure ideal customer outcomes.
- Plan, prioritize, and deliver team-related projects, balancing day-to-day operations with longer-term improvement initiatives.
- Identify process improvement opportunities, propose changes, and amend SOPs once approved.
A day in the life
Our team supports customers impacted by issues with Amazon's first-party products and services (Kindle, Echo, Appstore, Prime Video, etc.). We provide critical communications and take proactive actions to resolve their concerns, reducing the need for customers to contact customer service and improving their overall experience.
Program Specialists manage requests related to D2, collaborating one-to-one with requesting teams to identify optimal solutions for business POCs and impacted customers. Work varies daily - from stakeholder management and content creation to data handling. Once approved, specialists use various tools to execute large-scale actions: mass communications, push notifications, refunds, and order cancellations.
- Work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, or holidays in a 24/7/365 environment
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
- Experience working with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Work all days and shifts, including overtime (24 hours a day, 7 days a week operation, including holidays)
- Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience in a highly agile environment
- Experience in content writing

amazon-10599308.body:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
Providing real-time customer experience

NOC (Network Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting India. It ensures timely tracking procurement and movement between various Amazon hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
1. Watch CCTV camera recordings from Amazon operations sites and check whether the activities on video follow the correct process, by answering a set of defined audit questions for each site.
2. Use the camera viewing software to find and open the right camera for a given location and time, and look closely at the footage to spot any process gaps or incorrect handling.
3. Complete the number of audits assigned for your shift each day, keeping both speed and accuracy at the expected level.
4. Build familiarity with how each site is laid out, how packages move through it, and how the cameras are named and positioned, so that you can quickly locate the correct footage to review.
5. Record your findings in the audit system, take screenshots as proof wherever a process is not being followed, and save that proof in the right place within the required time.
6. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, and raise anything unclear or unusual to your team lead or manager.
7. Share your audit results on the schedule set for each audit type, whether that is daily, weekly, or once in two weeks.
8. Treat all video footage and findings as confidential, and follow the rules on data privacy and camera access at all times.
9. Take part in the training and practice when you join, including watching experienced auditors at work and then being observed yourself, and learn to handle more than one type of audit.
10. Meet the quality standards set for audit accuracy, and take part in the review sessions that check and improve the quality of audits.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities

amazon-10566666.body:
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. 
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience managing and or coordinating projects in a fast pace environment
- Experience in Excel with advanced proficiency (pivots, lookups, etc.)
- Master's degree or equivalent in operations research, applied mathematics, theoretical computer science, or equivalent, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate

amazon-10595199.body:
The EU International Technology (EU INTech) charter for Partner Growth and Experiences (PGX) is established to deliver coherent and personalised experiences for Selling Partners (SP) and Amazon teams, enabling them to manage their business growth across Amazon WW stores as a single-store experience, benefiting Amazon customers by accelerating Amazon flywheel. Our mission is to delight Customers and enable long-term success of Selling Partners by building the most trusted shopping experiences and a suite of services, tools and experiences that drive efficiency, growth and transparency for both, our Selling Partners and internal Retail teams, throughout their selling journey and across regions.
PGX is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist with machine learning background to help build and/or enhance our partner facing experiences and make it efficient and less human dependent. Our mission is to provide a delightful experience to Amazon’s selling partners by pushing the envelope in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and use human judgement when it is absolutely necessary, through leverage of Machine Learning (ML) and Aritifical Intelligence (AI) across the experiences we own.
Key job responsibilities
As a Applied Scientist with PGX, you will work alongside recognized experts and business stakeholders to develop novel algorithms and modeling techniques to advance the state-of-the-art in AI and human language technology. Your work will directly impact both our end customers and selling partners, in the form of products and services that build or own. You will gain hands on experience with Amazon’s AI and ML solutions and models, structured data sources, and large-scale computing resources to fully automate our selling partner facing experiences and use human judgement when it is absolutely required. We are looking for AS with experience/expertise/exposure in building large-scale high-performing systems.
A day in the life
1. Perform hands-on data analysis and modeling with large data sets to develop insights that increase device usage and customer experience
2. Use a broad range of data structures and algorithms to quantify business impact and develop offline code for new stats or applications
3. Run A/B experiments and evaluate the impact of their optimizations
4. Work closely with other scientists, software development engineers as well as program and product managers to design experiments and implement end-to-end solutions.
5. Communicate their results to various business stakeholders. 
6. Set up and monitor alarms to detect anomalous data patterns. Perform root cause analyses to explain and address anomalous data patterns.
About the team
EU INTech PGX's mission is to delight Customers and enable long-term success of Selling Partners by building the most trusted shopping experiences and a suite of services, tools and experiences that drive efficiency, growth and transparency for both, our Selling Partners and internal Retail teams, throughout their selling journey and across regions.Amazon’s Partner Growth Experience team, you will assume advanced ownership of designing, developing, and evolving mission-critical systems that empower Amazon’s Selling Partners at scale. 
This Applied Science role builds upon foundational engineering excellence to drive strategic leadership, ensuring solutions align with Amazon’s long-term vision for partner enablement and marketplace growth.
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

amazon-10591022.body:
Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, hungry and passionate about e-commerce? Are you an experienced professional with a strong work ethic and a bias for action? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. The ideal candidate is energized by digging into messy data, forming a hypothesis, finding the root cause, and driving a fix to closure across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for an Operations Specialist who shares Amazon's passion for the customer, someone who understands that a dependable delivery and fulfillment experience is central to how both sellers and buyers experience the Amazon platform.
In this role, you will work closely with sellers, seller support, customer service, sales, and third-party carriers to identify delivery and fulfillment issues that sellers face, and resolve their acute and short-term problems. You will investigate why sellers struggle with or leave fulfillment programs, separate seller-owned gaps from Amazon-owned gaps, and recommend specific fixes. You will also partner with product management teams to translate recurring seller pain points into longer-term features and programs that improve the seller and customer experience.
Key job responsibilities
Monitor operational performance and partner with other teams (third-party carriers, customer service, seller support, product, operations) to resolve performance issues and keep metrics within goal.
Monitor and drive seller-impacting operational tickets and escalations to resolution within defined service levels, flagging anything at risk of breaching its window ahead of time.
Run structured deep dives into seller friction and program attrition: pull and sanity-check the data yourself, form a hypothesis, establish the root cause with transaction-level evidence, identify whether the gap sits with the seller or with Amazon, and recommend a fix.
Review and investigate incoming seller issues and feedback from multiple sources, and route each finding to the right team with a clear owner and next step, leaving nothing open at the end of the week.
Size cost and savings opportunities across marketplaces and fulfillment methods, explaining what the numbers mean rather than passing dashboard output through unchanged.
Build and run recurring operational reports (including automating them where possible) and produce weekly business-review inputs that lead with the headline metric, the week-over-week movement, and the reason for any change.
Gather and analyze seller contacts and feedback to develop seller-experience improvement suggestions, and work with Product Managers on solutions.
Must be open to working on Saturday and Sunday, with any other 2 days of the week off.
- 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.
Key job responsibilities
• Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
• Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
• Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.

• Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
• Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
• Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
• Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
• Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.

amazon-10578563.body:
Amazon's Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) is an independent self-publishing service launched in November 2007, concurrently with the first Amazon Kindle device that allows authors of any level to engage millions of readers that shop on Amazon. The KDP Customer Support Analyst will be the front-line interface between Amazon and publishers/content providers who use the KDP's self-publishing platform to publish, market, and sell their content in Amazon's Kindle store. The KDP Customer Support Analyst will work towards ensuring all the concerns from the publishers are duly attended. Kindle Direct Publishing offers a team environment that thrives on innovation and excellence, and our staff is talented, and passionate about creating an exceptional customer experience. If you want to work for a team who delights customers, solves problems, and is the face of our company, then the KDP Customer Support Analyst role is the job for you!
Key job responsibilities
* Process and respond to email, phone, and chat contacts received from KDP website users
* Demonstrate clear and polite written and verbal communication
* Maintain a positive and professional demeanor at all times
* Meet or exceed all quality, productivity, and time management goals as set by management.
* Follow all site performance and behavior expectations as outlined by management.
* Demonstrate an appropriate sense of urgency for email response times and phone & chat service levels
* Follow company policies and processes in order to process customer requests appropriately
* Use customer service tools and software to troubleshoot, provide an accurate response, and create an exceptional customer experience
* Escalate customer issues appropriately and in a timely manner
* Proactively communicate system & process issues
* Proactively strive to drive improvement to the internal and external processes to enhance the customer experience
* Contact appropriate teams as needed for systemic issues
* Detail oriented and process focused. Must be able to follow processes and document research & interactions in clear and concise manner.
* Flexibility to work shifts including overnight and weekends
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Should be willing to work from the office as VCC is not available.
- Minimum of 1 year experience handling multiple forms of direct customer inquiries via calls, chats and/or emails.
- Adequate communication skills.
- Proven ability to provide high quality customer service in a fast-changing environment by developing personalized responses for publisher questions.
- Must possess computer navigation skills, along with a basic understanding on how to use a website/web browser and the internet.
- Must possess analytical skills
- Must be able to research, replicate, categorize, and document customer issues to identify & understand their problems.
- Must have a proven ability to use data and research to inform the best course of action and/or possible resolutions
- Must have high speed internet services that comply with the below recommendation:
- An Octane 2.0 score of 30,000 or greater
- Network latency of 150 ms or less
- Download speed of 3 Mbps or greater
- Additional computer skills certifications in web technologies are preferable.
- Experience in web-enabled software products or services is highly preferred.
- Should be able to understand a complex problem and respond to authors.
- Basic familiarity with web technologies and HTML is highly desirable.
- Analytical skills required. Must be able to understand problems that authors are facing, categorize, document, and decide when and to whom to escalate them.
- Detail-oriented and process-focused. Must be able to follow the process and document interactions as per requirements in clear and concise manner.
- College graduates.

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.

The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.

Essential Responsibilities:
• Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
• Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy

• Other duties as assigned

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience with end-to-end ownership of major project deliverables
- Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
- Basic US legislation Leave of Absence, Disability and/or Accommodations knowledge, specifically ADA/ADAAA and FMLA
- Prior Leave and/or Accommodations experience, to include: previous work in a leave of absence and/or disability claim management role, with experience using case management systems, reviewing cases for eligibility, determining the appropriate leave and/or disability pay benefits that apply to a specific situation, and establishing/executing a case management plan.

amazon-10596216.body:
Amazon’s vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company; to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online. 
Amazon's diverse online business requires VAT filings in a number of jurisdictions across Europe and creates specific VAT compliance obligations relating to third parties (3P) that sell via our websites. These 3P obligations are the responsibility of the European Tax and Trade Compliance Ops team (TTOPs). We are looking for a number of Compliance Specialists to join us in Bangalore. This is a multiple headcount hire, which will involve working within the part of the team that is responsible for checking the VAT compliance status of our 3P sellers, providing 3P data to tax authorities, and controlling the access of 3P sellers to our websites. Work may also include some mainstream VAT compliance activities, supporting internal and external audits, and liaising with colleagues in TTOPs as well as Tax and the wider business. 
All candidates will be analytical and capable of succeeding in a fast-paced team environment. You will need an understanding of financial systems, and technical accounting awareness for this work. You may also be involved in projects that have a VAT compliance impact. You will be expected to take ownership of your activities, identify process improvement opportunities for existing process and controls, and drive positive change across the organization.
Productivity and quality assurance will be evaluated along with the overall contribution to the development of the department.
Basic/Preferred Qualifications:
• Any Bachelor’s Degree.
• Ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality and data security standards 
• Excellent written and spoken English skills and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex transactional issues correctly and clearly to both internal and external customers
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make complex investigation decisions with little to no guidance 
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to analyze problems logically 
• Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive and detail oriented 
• Strong time management and organizational skills
• Demonstrate flexibility to work in different tasks with increased complexity based on current business needs
• proficiency in Microsoft Excel • MS Office

• Assist with VAT registrations across various jurisdictions;
• Respond to VAT compliance queries from Amazon businesses operating across Europe

amazon-10594254.body:
Amazon is seeking a Tax Analyst to join its Direct Tax Reporting team in Hyderabad, India. This role supports the Worldwide CapEx team with the reporting of US income tax consequences for Amazon’s unparalleled portfolio of assets. Areas of focus include operating and finance leases, depreciation of fixed assets, amortization of intangibles, and cost recovery of digital content.
A successful candidate will have excellent organizational and communication skills, great attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a deadline-driven, dynamic environment. Experience with technology tools to automate the organization of vast amounts of data into useful information is essential.
Responsibilities
- Assist in preparation of Amazon’s US income tax provision, forecast, and tax returns as it relates to CapEx transactions by analyzing US GAAP reporting, determining book-tax differences, preparing workpapers and technical memorandums, and performing tax law research 
- Assist in preparation of deferred tax reconciliations for CapEx assets; identify drivers of basis differences
- Identify and assist in implementing process improvements which increase efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of data
- Assist in build and implementation of analysis and metrics reports to be communicated to tax management, finance partners, and external auditors 
- Assist in coordinating information requests with business partners and external service providers to ensure accurate and timely inclusion within various tax reporting deliverables
- Participate in special projects as assigned
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) from an accredited institution
- 2+ years of US income taxation experience, specifically corporate taxation and consolidated corporate tax compliance
Preferred Qualifications
- Chartered Accountant, Certified Public Accountant, or Enrolled Agent certification
- Experience with US income tax reporting for CapEx transactions
- Experience with ASC 740 
- Experience with CorpTax tax return preparation or equivalent software
- Experience with Oracle Fixed Assets, BNA Fixed Assets, or equivalent software
- Strong proficiency with accounting principles, processes, and entries
- Experience working with US-based team members specifically within income tax operations
- Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently
- Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
- Proven project management experience in a fast-paced environment 
- Self-starter; must have strong desire to help improve processes for scalability, efficiency, and accuracy
- Minimum experience with Excel should be intermediate for managing large data sets
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department
- Knowledge of accounting principles, processes, and entries

amazon-10590820.body:
This is a contractual role for 12 Months
Join our Finance Operations team to ensure accurate invoice processing and maintain the financial integrity of our accounts payable operations. You'll work with our ERP system to match invoices, resolve discrepancies, and support our vendor payment processes while maintaining high accuracy standards.
Key job responsibilities
Match invoices from the ERP system to supporting documentation and resolve discrepancies to maintain accuracy standards above 98%

Prepare vendor statements and reconciliations to support vendor relationships and financial reporting
Perform quality checks on processed invoices to verify accuracy and compliance with established procedures
Meet established productivity targets while maintaining quality standards
A day in the life
As a FinOps Analyst in our Accounts Payable team, you'll focus on invoice matching within our ERP system, working to resolve variances between vendor invoices and our internal records. Your day includes reviewing matched invoices for quality assurance, researching credits and returns to ensure accurate accounting, investigating payment holds, and preparing vendor statements. You'll collaborate with our finance team to address complex matching issues and contribute to our shared services environment where efficiency and accuracy are equally valued. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in financial operations while supporting the broader finance function across our organization.
About the team
We are a collaborative Finance Operations team dedicated to maintaining accurate and efficient accounts payable processes. Our team serves internal stakeholders and external vendors by ensuring timely and accurate payment processing. We're focused on building a reliable financial foundation that supports our organization's growth, and we value team members who bring attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement. You'll work alongside colleagues who are invested in supporting one another and maintaining the highest standards of financial accuracy.

- 1+ years of Accounts Payable (AP) experience

Key responsibilities:
Finance Analyst will be a finance partner to the relevant business team. This includes, among other things, responsibility for financial metrics, reporting, forecasting and analysis. The successful candidate will be strategic, analytical, and have the demonstrated ability to effectively manage finances of a high-growth business:
 Perform financial reporting and support monthly P&L analysis and Financial forecasts.
 Support in monthly/quarterly financial closing activity in close co-ordination with business and accounting teams
 Closely monitor and control opex budget for the business. Evaluate and question the opex requirements and continuously benchmark cost productivity for the business.
 Facilitate financial review meetings with business groups and work with business managers to ensure effective finance and cost management.
 Assist in Measuring and reporting progress on key goals for the business team in a timely manner
 Measuring and monitoring of metrics for new business initiatives
 Provide inputs for monthly and quarterly business reviews in a timely manner. Facilitate the business reviews with data analysis and follow through with business leaders on actionable items for improving business metrics over a period of time.
 Perform ad-hoc business analyses, and financial modeling. Present recommendations to senior management on strategic decisions, and planned future initiatives.
