unstop-1793055.body:
About Us: 
 Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.
 Our Leaders: 
 Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.
 Vamsi Krishna - Co-Founder and CEO
 Pulkit Jain - Co-Founder and Head of Product
 Anand Prakash - Co-Founder and Head of Academics
 Arnab Dutta - COO
 Pankaj Jain - CFO
 Simriti Goel - Head of HR
 Working Days: 6 days a week
 Tuesday to Sunday
 Working Hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.
 Location: Bangalore.
 Summary of the Role: 
 We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
 Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
 End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
 Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
 Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
 Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
 Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
 Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
 Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)
 What’s in it for You? 
 Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures.
 Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
 Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Overview 
 Are you passionate about startups, entrepreneurship and bringing people together? Join Cerebera® Build as a Community Management Intern and help us grow a community of students, aspiring entrepreneurs and startup founders.
 About Cerebera® Build 
 Cerebera® Build is a FREE AI business app that helps students, aspiring entrepreneurs and startup founders turn ideas into businesses. It brings customers, invoices, a simple website and more into one place, with CAI, your AI co-founder, to guide you.
 We're building a community where people can discover the tools, knowledge and support they need to start their own businesses.
 What You'll Do 
 Build and grow a community of aspiring entrepreneurs and startup founders on campus.
 Promote Cerebera® Build through college connections, clubs, E-cells, student groups and social media.
 Connect with students interested in startups, side hustles and entrepreneurship.
 Introduce potential users to Cerebera® Build and demonstrate how the app works.
 Share your unique referral link or QR code to track verified installs.
 Submit weekly progress updates and participate in short check-in calls.
 Who Can Apply? 
 College or university students aged 18 and above.
 Students interested in startups, marketing, community building or technology.
 Good communicators who enjoy networking and connecting with people.
 Access to a campus community, college club or student network.
 No prior experience required.
 A Paid Internship Opportunity 
 This is a one-month paid internship .
 To successfully complete the internship and qualify for the internship certificate, you must achieve a minimum of 150 verified installs within one month through your unique referral link or QR code.
 You'll receive promotional materials, a pitch script, a demo video and weekly guidance to help you achieve your target.
 How You’re Paid: 
 Fixed Stipend: Rs 3,000 when you reach 150 verified installs.
 Incentive: Rs 1,000 for every full extra 100 verified installs above 150.
 Maximum: Rs 8,000, reached at 650 verified installs.
 Verified Installs and Earnings: 
 Under 150: Not eligible for the stipend or certificate.
 150 verified installs: Rs 3,000.
 250 verified installs: Rs 4,000.
 350 verified installs: Rs 5,000.
 450 verified installs: Rs 6,000.
 550 verified installs: Rs 7,000.
 650 verified installs (maximum): Rs 8,000.
 What You'll Gain 
 Hands-on community management and growth marketing experience.
 Experience building a startup community from the ground up.
 Exposure to AI-powered business tools and entrepreneurship.
 Practical networking and communication skills.
 A structured, goal-oriented internship with hands-on experience.
 An internship certificate upon achieving the minimum requirement of 150 verified installs.
 Duration: 1 month
 Ready to build a community of future founders? 
 Join Cerebera® Build and help more people take their first step towards entrepreneurship.

unstop-1791051.body:
Roles 
 • Run go-to-market for three live AI products — NoteSathi, Geet and TurtleReel — on
  your own campus for two months.
• About 5–6 hours a week, work from home. The only in-person part is one demo or
  activity on your own campus each month.
• You work directly with the founder, not a manager.
 Responsibility 
 • Share your own referral links in class groups and on your social accounts, with an
  honest line on what the product actually did for you.
• Run one live demo a month on campus — a canteen or library desk-to-desk, a club
  session, or a fest stall.
• Post 4+ stories or posts a month using the content kit we give you.
• Send a short weekly update: what you posted, what worked, what flopped.

 What you will learn 
 • Positioning — why the same product needs a different pitch for a first-year, a
  hostel warden and a club secretary.
• Social selling — hooks that stop a scroll, demos shot on your own phone, and which
  format actually converts.
• Funnel thinking — link, install, first use, purchase. You find your weakest step in
  your own numbers and fix it.
• Customer conversations — real objections, answered without overpromising.
• Reading your own data — form a theory, test it, report what happened.
• Marketing ethics — disclosure, consent and honest claims.
 Requirements 
 • 18+, currently enrolled at a college in India.
• An active Instagram account and access to your class WhatsApp groups.
• Willing to do one in-person demo a month on your own campus.
• Able to commit 5–6 hours a week for two months.
• No prior sales experience needed. We care more about your written answers than
  your follower count.

unstop-1783257.body:
MAVR is hiring for Business Development Executive 
 About the Company 
 MAVR is looking for a Business Development Executive to help grow its customer base by identifying potential clients, starting conversations, understanding their needs, presenting MAVR's solutions, and converting qualified prospects into onboarded customers.
 This is a revenue-focused role. You will own opportunities from initial prospecting through follow-up, conversion, and onboarding.
 Responsibilities 
 Identify and generate new business leads through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, and other relevant channels.
 Research and build lists of potential customers aligned with MAVR's target market.
 Reach out to prospects through calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn, and direct outreach.
 Qualify leads based on their needs, business potential, and fit with MAVR.
 Conduct product introductions, sales conversations, and demonstrations with prospective customers.
 Clearly communicate how MAVR can solve relevant problems for trainers, gyms, and other customers within the fitness ecosystem.
 Maintain consistent follow-ups with qualified prospects until a clear outcome is reached.
 Handle common questions, objections, and commercial discussions during the sales process.
 Convert qualified opportunities into paying or onboarded customers.
 Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from sale to customer onboarding.
 Maintain accurate records of leads, conversations, follow-ups, pipeline stages, and outcomes.
 Share market feedback, customer objections, and recurring requirements with the product and leadership teams.
 Work toward agreed lead generation, conversion, onboarding, and revenue targets.
 Requirements 
 At least 1 year of experience in sales, business development, client acquisition, or a similar customer-facing role; freshers are also welcome to apply.
 Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
 Comfort with outbound sales, prospecting, and cold outreach.
 Ability to understand a customer's problem before presenting a solution.
 Strong follow-up discipline and ownership of opportunities.
 Confidence in conducting sales calls and product demonstrations.
 Basic understanding of CRM or sales pipeline management.
 Ability to negotiate and move opportunities toward closure.
 Self-driven and comfortable working against measurable business targets.
 Experience selling SaaS, technology products, fitness services, or B2B solutions is an advantage, but strong sales ability and ownership are more important.
 How success will be measured 
 Success in this role is not based only on activity. MAVR will assess the quality of leads generated, qualified opportunities created, meetings conducted, conversions achieved, customers successfully onboarded, and revenue generated. The goal is to find the right prospects, build relationships, demonstrate value, and turn qualified opportunities into real customers.

 Assist with proposals, presentations, documentation, business reports, and sales-related follow-up activities.
 Prepare and update PowerPoint presentations and supporting sales materials.
 Coordinate with internal technology and delivery teams to collect information for client communication and business proposals.
 Track action items and support timely coordination across teams working on IT, IoT, cloud, automation, and digital transformation solutions.
 Contribute to market and prospect research and help identify information relevant to ASPR Technology’s technology offerings.
 Requirements 
 Graduates or candidates pursuing a relevant degree in Business, Management, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
 Freshers with enthusiasm to build a career in sales operations within the IT Services and Consulting industry are encouraged to apply.
 Good working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, email, and standard office productivity tools.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Good coordination, follow-up, organization, and attention-to-detail skills.
 A positive attitude and strong willingness to learn new processes, tools, and technology concepts.
 Ability to take ownership of assigned activities and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
 Willingness to learn about IT services, IoT, infrastructure, automation, rapid application development, cloud management, AI, APIs, chatbots, and RPA solutions.
 Ability to work from the Noida office for the complete six-month internship.
 This is a paid, full-time, on-site internship offering a monthly stipend of ₹15,000. The selected intern will gain practical experience in sales coordination, CRM and record management, MIS reporting, proposal support, PowerPoint presentations, and cross-functional collaboration in a technology-led business.

unstop-1774926.body:
Fastinfo Legal Services Private Limited is hiring for Customer Care Executive 
 About the Company 
 Fastinfo Legal Services Private Limited is hiring Customer Care Executives to support its growing sales and operations function in Kolkata. This opportunity is suitable for freshers and experienced candidates who want to build a career in customer engagement, service coordination, and business operations.
 Responsibilities 
 Handle customer conversations professionally through assigned communication channels.
 Understand customer requirements and provide clear, accurate information about the company’s services.
 Support sales and operations objectives through timely follow-ups and effective coordination.
 Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and escalate complex concerns when necessary.
 Work according to the assigned shift schedule and rotational weekly-off arrangement.
 Requirements 
 Minimum qualification of 12th pass or graduation.
 Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
 Good spoken communication skills in English and Hindi.
 Customer-focused attitude, professional conduct, and willingness to work in a target-oriented environment.
 Ability to work from the office in Salt Lake, Sector V, Kolkata, in either the 9:00 AM–6:00 PM or 12:00 PM–9:00 PM shift.
 The position offers a fixed annual CTC range of ₹2.5 LPA to ₹2.88 LPA, along with attractive incentives. The role requires working six days a week with one rotational weekly off. Candidates who are motivated to develop their communication, customer service, sales, and operations skills are encouraged to apply.

unstop-1782464.body:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Customer Success Representative to strengthen customer relationships, enhance the post-purchase experience, and gather meaningful customer insights. The role involves engaging with customers after their purchase, understanding their experiences, encouraging authentic customer advocacy, and identifying opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and brand perception.
 The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to build lasting relationships through professional and empathetic interactions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Engagement & Relationship Management 
 Connect with customers after purchase to understand their product experience and overall satisfaction.
 Build positive, long-term relationships through timely and personalized communication.
 Proactively engage with customers to ensure a smooth and satisfying post-purchase journey.
 Address customer queries, concerns, and product-related challenges with professionalism.
 Customer Feedback & Brand Advocacy 
 Encourage customers to share their genuine experiences and product feedback through appropriate platforms.
 Facilitate the collection of customer testimonials, product experience insights, and satisfaction inputs.
 Promote customer advocacy by creating positive engagement opportunities with the brand.
 Identify satisfied customers who may be willing to share their experiences with prospective buyers.
 Customer Satisfaction & Experience Improvement 
 Gather actionable insights regarding product quality, usability, packaging, delivery, and after-sales service.
 Identify recurring customer concerns and communicate them to the relevant internal teams.
 Recommend improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and the overall brand experience.
 Follow up with customers to ensure their concerns are addressed effectively.
 Customer Communication & Follow-ups 
 Manage customer outreach through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and other approved communication channels.
 Maintain a structured follow-up schedule to improve customer engagement and response rates.
 Ensure all customer interactions are courteous, timely, and aligned with brand communication standards.
 Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, feedback, and resolutions.
 Reporting & Performance Tracking

unstop-1782386.body:
About the Company 
 Sernion Technologies Private Limited operates in the IT hardware, peripherals, networking and CCTV solutions market.  A two-wheeler and valid driving licence would be advantageous.
 The role offers a fixed salary of ₹20,000 per month along with target-based performance incentives. Performance will be assessed through qualified leads, new partners onboarded, customer meetings, market coverage, orders generated, collections, repeat business and growth of the local customer base.

unstop-1780750.body:
About the Company 
 HealthPlix Technologies Private Limited is a doctor-first health-tech company that empowers healthcare professionals through technology. Its digital healthcare solutions help doctors streamline clinical workflows and support better patient outcomes. The finance team enables this mission by building accurate, scalable and dependable financial processes.
 Responsibilities 
 Raise B2B and B2C invoices in Zoho Books using approved contracts and billing inputs, while tracking unbilled items, credit notes and invoice corrections.
 Monitor customer receipts, maintain receivables ageing and coordinate timely follow-ups with relevant teams.
 Reconcile Razorpay collections, settlements, refunds, fees and automated payouts against bank statements and accounting records, resolving exceptions promptly.
 Perform bank reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, routine journal entries and supporting schedules for the month-end close.
 Prepare and reconcile information for GST returns, including GSTR-1, and support TDS accounting and quarterly compliance activities.
 Maintain audit-ready documentation and provide reconciliations, schedules and evidence for statutory, tax and internal audits.
 Maintain billing, collections and reconciliation trackers and identify practical improvements to finance processes and reporting.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting or Finance; CA Inter or a postgraduate qualification is an advantage but not mandatory.
 2–4 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance operations, preferably within a technology, SaaS, healthcare-tech or services business.
 Working knowledge of Indian GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and month-end accounting.
 Experience with accounting software; Zoho Books and Razorpay experience will be preferred.
 Good Excel skills, strong attention to detail, accountability and the ability to manage recurring deadlines.
 Success in this role means delivering accurate and timely invoicing, completing bank and Razorpay reconciliations regularly, resolving differences with clear tracking, and maintaining reliable receivables, month-end and compliance support.

unstop-1778047.body:
Summary of the Role: 
 We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions. This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp. 
 Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations. 
 End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding. 
 Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets. 
 Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage. 
 Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree. 
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection. 
 Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection. 
 Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech). 
 What’s in it for You? 
 Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. 
 Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months. 
 Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

 As an Associate, you will be the operational spine of Source's trade execution. 
 You will own the complete order lifecycle — from order punching and supplier coordination to dispatch confirmation and customer delivery.

 Who You Are  
 The Executor: Obsessed with closing loops — every order opened is an order that must be delivered and reconciled.  
 The Communicator: Clear and direct with internal teams and external partners, leaving no room for misalignment.  
 The Detail-Orientated: Catches discrepancies before they become problems — in grades, quantities, pricing, and documentation.

Title – Retail Sales Associate  
 Reporting to – Store Manager  
 Skip Level – Area Operations Manager  
 About Lenskart   
 With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers’ eye powers. Backed by IDG  Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.  
 About the Role  
 Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.  
 Responsibilities: 
 Customer Focus 
 Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
 He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
 He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
 He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has.
 Product Recommendation 
 With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
 He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
 Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence 
 Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently.
 Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse.
 He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer.
 In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
 Store upkeep & maintenance 
 He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly.
 He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.
 Personal attributes & Competencies 
 Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
 Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
 Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
 Clear articulation and active listening skills
 Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
 Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
 Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

unstop-1714449.body:
About Trent Limited
 Trent Limited , a part of the  Tata Group , is one of India's leading retail companies, operating iconic brands such as  Westside  and  Zudio . With a rapidly expanding retail footprint, Trent leverages data and technology to power critical business decisions across merchandising, customer insights, inventory optimization, and operational excellence.
 Job Description: Data Scientist 
 Function:  AI & Data Science   |    Location:  Mumbai   |    Employment Type:  Full-time 
 Role Overview 
 As a Data Scientist, you will be part of the Data Science and AI team, turning retail data into actionable insights and drive change through technology. You will support data analysis, machine learning development, GenAI experimentation, and stakeholder communication. You will get an opportunity to work with structured data, text, documents, and images across several strategic business use cases. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the development of machine learning models for forecasting, classification, clustering, and recommendations. 
 Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. 
 Transform and validate structured and unstructured data, including text and images. 
 Work on AI and GenAI use cases such as summarization, information extraction, document processing, and image analysis. 
 Generate intelligent insights and communicate using visualizations 
 Collaborate with stakeholders and document methods, assumptions, and results. 
 Knowledge & Skills 
 Foundation in statistics, probability, and machine learning concepts. 
 Hands-on knowledge of Python, Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. 
 Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and manipulation. 
 Basic understanding of GenAI concepts such as LLMs, prompting, embeddings, vector search, and RAG. 
 Awareness of techniques for working with text and image data. 
 Ability to communicate insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Good to Have 
 Exposure to Azure, Databricks or other cloud platforms. 
 Exposure to building GenAI applications using LLM APIs, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, or similar tools. 
 Awareness of evaluating GenAI outputs for relevance, accuracy, quality, and hallucinations. 
 Basic knowledge of NLP, computer vision, deep learning, or time-series forecasting. 
 Familiarity with Git and collaborative development practices. 
 Familiarity with Power BI or similar visualization tools. 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics or a related quantitative discipline. 
 What We Offer 
 Opportunity to work on high-impact problems in a fast-paced retail environment. 
 Structured mentorship, guided learning pathways, and opportunities to learn from experienced team members and leaders.  
 Hands-on exposure to modern analytics, data science, and AI tools. 
 Career growth opportunities through cross-functional projects and real-world problem-solving. 
 Work Schedule 
 5 day working week; 2nd and 4th Saturdays are working days. 
 Recruitment Process
 The recruitment process consists of the following stages: 
 Data Science & Problem-Solving Assessment: Complete a structured assessment featuring aptitude, technical, coding, and applied data science questions, including a business case, to demonstrate your analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, technical proficiency, and business acumen.
 Virtual Interview Round:  Participate in a live technical interview to showcase your technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and ability to apply concepts to real-world scenarios. 
 In Person Interview Round:  Engage in a live discussion with the hiring team to assess your communication skills, professional experience, career aspirations, and overall fit for the role. 
 Offer Rollout: Candidates who successfully clear all stages of the recruitment process will receive an offer from Trent .

unstop-1755458.body:
POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED 
 Post Graduate Trainee – Sales (B2C) 
 Aarambh 2027 | B2C - Wires, Switchgears, Switches, Fans and Lighting  
 Polycab India Limited (PIL) is India’s largest manufacturer of Wires and Cables and one of the fastest growing FMEG companies with a consolidated turnover of ₹285+ Bn in FY26. PIL is at the forefront of providing innovative, safe and energy-efficient products to a diverse set of customers via a strong distribution network of 3,900+ authorized dealers and 190,000+ retail outlets. PIL’s business operations span across India through 26 manufacturing facilities, 15 offices and 35 warehouses. PIL has also served customers in 94 countries globally. PIL’s 4,500+ employees are dedicated to upholding robust governance practices, preserving a customer-centric culture, having a purpose to serve the communities, and imbibing a genuine sense of ecological consciousness. 
 For further information, please visit www.polycab.com 
 Role brief 
 This is a field sales role. You will spend most of your working day in the market, not in an office, and you will start in a Tier 3 town or city rather than a metro. 
 You will be in the market on roughly 20 to 25 days a month, visiting dealers, distributors and retail outlets. 
 A typical day starts in the market by mid-morning and involves visiting 12 to 20 outlets on a fixed beat plan, mostly on a two-wheeler and on foot. 
 You will be placed in a Tier 3 town or city where we have business — not a metro, and not necessarily your home state. This holds for your initial period. Larger territories in Tier 2 cities come later, for those identified as high potential. 
 Saturdays are working days. Market holidays vary by region and may not match a standard weekend. 
 This is not a desk role, a marketing role or an analytics role. Reporting and system entries are part of the job, but they happen around market working, not instead of it. 
 If that sounds like the kind of work you want, read on. If it does not, this is not the right role for you — and that is a perfectly reasonable conclusion to reach. 
 Your first six months: Click Here 
 There are structured check-ins through this period with your mentor and business head, so you always know where you stand. Confirmation follows at six months, based on your progress. 
 After confirmation - Territory Sales In-charge 
 You own a set of outlets in a Tier 3 market. Broadly, that means: 
 Delivering secondary sales for your outlets, and growing the retailer base 
 Managing dealer and distributor relationships, including stock, claims and collections 
 Expanding reach — adding outlets, improving counter share, placing new products 
 Executing schemes and promotions, and tracking what they deliver 
 Reading your market — competition activity, pricing movement, demand shifts — and reporting it back 
 Eligibility 
 2027 batch MBA (Marketing, Sales or related), with no active backlogs 
 B.E. / B. Tech (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation) alongside the MBA  
 Minimum 60% in 10th, 12th and graduation 
 What we look for 
 Comfort with people, you will spend your day in conversation with dealers, retailers and customers 
 Resilience. Some days you will hear no more often than yes. 
 Willingness to travel and to relocate 
 Self-direction. Nobody is watching you in the market; you set your own pace. 
 Who this role suits 
 You want to learn how a business actually makes money, at the point where it happens 
 You are energised by being out and about rather than at a desk 
 You want a clear, performance-linked path into sales leadership 
 Who it does not suit 
 You are looking for a corporate or head-office role 
 You want predictable hours in a fixed location 
 You would prefer a strategy, marketing or analytics profile 
 Where this leads 
 Territory Sales In-charge → Territory Sales Manager → Area Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → National Sales Manager. Movement is based on performance. 
 Post-Confirmation Compensation 
 Post-confirmation CTC, for Sales roles - INR 7,35,000 as Fixed pay + 20% Incentive 
 Post-confirmation CTC, for non-Sales roles - INR 7,35,000 as Fixed pay + 10% Performance pay

unstop-1784087.body:
Are you someone who loves getting things done? You might be our person! 
 We’re looking for a Founder’s Office Intern who can help us with all the little (and sometimes not-so-little) things that go into growing a business.
 One day, you might be reaching out to influencers. The next day, you might be making reports, following up with people, or helping us figure out our next marketing move.
 Basically, you’ll get a little taste of marketing, business development, and operations — all while working directly with the founder. No two days have to look the same!
 What will you be doing? 
 Social Media: Engage with people, interact with relevant accounts, cross-post content, and occasionally create stories or simple carousels. Don't worry, the founder handles the reels!
 Influencer & Creator Outreach: Find influencers, reach out to potential collaborators, follow up, and help make collaborations happen.
 Business Development: Help us connect with potential customers, collaborators, and other people who can help the business grow.
 Operations & Reporting: Prepare reports, organise data, track tasks, and make sure things don't get lost in the famous “I'll do it later” zone.
 Customer Feedback: Make feedback calls, collect responses, follow up on conversations, and help us understand what people think.
 Founder’s Office Tasks: Basically, help with whatever needs to get done to move the business forward. You'll get to see how things work behind the scenes!
 Who should apply? 
 Freshers, college graduates, or anyone looking to gain practical work experience.
 Someone who is proactive, organised, curious, and comfortable figuring things out.
 Someone who can communicate well, follow up without being reminded 17 times, and take ownership of tasks.
 Basic knowledge of Instagram, Canva, Google Sheets, and digital marketing is a plus — but a willingness to learn matters more.
 Women returning from a career break or anyone looking for a flexible opportunity is absolutely welcome to apply.
 No fancy degree or years of experience required. Just bring your common sense, curiosity, and a little initiative!
 The Work Details
 Role: Founder’s Office Intern
 Mode: 2 days from Office, 4 from Home
 Stipend: ₹10k per month (Show me what you can do)
 Duration: Minimum 3 months
 Time Commitment: 5–6 hours a day 
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)
 Timings: Flexible, as long as the work gets done and communication stays consistent
 Location: Bangalore-based candidates are a plus, but not a requirement.
 We start the week with a call, align on weekly priorities, and then break things down into daily tasks. You'll know what needs to be done, and we'll keep each other updated along the way.
 What happens after 3 months? 
 This isn't meant to be just another internship certificate for your resume.
 Based on your performance, ownership, and fit with the business, there's an opportunity to move into a full-time Business Development role , with increased compensation.
 A little disclaimer: 
 This role is for someone who likes getting things done, not someone who needs a reminder for every single task. You don't need to know everything on Day 1, but you should be willing to learn, take initiative, and figure things out.
 If you enjoy being part of the action and want to understand how a business actually grows, this could be a great place to start!
 Interested? Send your resume along with a few lines about yourself and why you'd be a good fit. Freshers are welcome!
 Let's build something good together.

 Support cost reduction initiatives through alternate sourcing research and price comparisons.

unstop-1785417.body:
About the Company 
 BRIGHT INDIA TRADERS is a textile manufacturer and supplier based in Erode, Tamil Nadu, operating since 2005. The company produces bedsheets, towels, cleaning cloths, floor dusters and other home-textile products. It serves government departments through the GeM platform, institutions, and buyers across India and international markets. This internship offers practical exposure to government procurement, tender operations, sourcing and applied AI in a growing textile business.
 Responsibilities 
 Search GeM and other government portals each day for relevant tenders, using custom GPTs, Claude and other AI tools while verifying every detail against the original tender.
 Maintain a daily tracker covering quantities, specifications, eligibility, EMD, delivery timelines and closing dates.
 Call and email government departments to clarify incomplete or unclear tender requirements.
 Prepare tender documents manually and then using the in-house AI system, Claude Brain, checking every line at least twice.
 Upload and update products, categories and rates on the GeM portal.
 Source products not manufactured in-house by identifying suppliers, comparing quotations, following up on samples, purchase orders and deliveries.
 Build simple internal tools such as purchase approvals, quote trackers and tender checklists, and automate repetitive work with AI and no-code platforms.
 Requirements 
 Open to fresh graduates, final-year students and undergraduates from any academic background, including BBA, B.Com, BMS, MBA, technology, engineering and other disciplines.
 No prior tender experience is required and full training will be provided.
 Clear spoken and written English. Tamil, Hindi or Kannada is an advantage.
 Strong attention to detail, basic Excel or Google Sheets ability, genuine interest in AI and confidence speaking with government offices and suppliers.
 Own laptop and commitment to complete the full six-month internship, working Monday to Friday for at least five to six hours daily.
 Experience with AI automation tools such as GPTs, Zapier, Make or n8n, AI/no-code product building, digital marketing, content creation, GeM, tendering or purchasing is an added advantage.
 The internship is hybrid in Bangalore with two openings and a monthly stipend of ₹5,000. Outstanding performers may receive a Pre-Placement Offer with compensation of up to ₹20,000 per month. Interns will receive a certificate, letter of recommendation, a five-day work week and direct mentorship from the founder.
 Screening Questions 
 Can you work Monday to Friday for at least five to six hours a day for the full six months? How will you manage this with college or exams?
 Which AI tools have you used, and what is one thing you did or built with them?
 Rate your Excel or Google Sheets skill as beginner, basic or good, and share one example.
 Are you comfortable calling government offices and suppliers you do not know?

 We’re building BharatCode, an artificial intelligence platform, and looking for people who want to help us grow our community from the ground up. Backed by IIMA Ventures and recently signed a pilot with Ashoka University.
 If you spend time on Reddit, Discord, enjoy building online communities, know your way around LinkedIn, or simply want to learn how an early-stage startup grows, this could be a good opportunity for you.

 Help us build and grow our Discord community.
 Engage with relevant communities on Reddit and introduce people to BharatCode where appropriate.

 Find creative ways to attract developers, students, and artificial intelligence enthusiasts to our platform.

 What matters most is your willingness to take ownership and get things done.

 Hands-on experience growing the community of an early-stage artificial intelligence startup.
 The opportunity to experiment with community building, content, and growth strategies.
 A chance to work closely with the BharatCode founding team and contribute your own ideas.
 The opportunity to take ownership of initiatives and see the impact of your work.
 A note on compensation 
 BharatCode is currently bootstrapped, and we have not yet secured funding. This is an unpaid opportunity at present. We intend to introduce compensation once we receive sufficient funding, but future payment is not guaranteed and will depend on funding and a confirmed compensation arrangement.
 Please apply only if you are comfortable with these terms.
 Interested in joining us?

 A seat in a brand launch from zero to one, working directly with the founding team.

 Free product, and real campaigns for your portfolio.
 A shot at a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Campus Outreach: Introduce Shreyapatha to relevant student communities and help build awareness of the organisation.
 Digital Promotion: Share approved content through permitted college groups, social media and student networks.
 Weekly Assignments: Complete structured tasks related to campus research, awareness campaigns and student engagement.

 Continuous Engagement: Maintain communication with the Shreyapatha team and participate in scheduled online check-ins.

 Students currently enrolled in colleges or universities across Karnataka.
 Students from any academic stream, including BBA, B.Com, MBA, engineering, arts, science and other degree programmes.
 Individuals with good communication, initiative and organisational skills.
 Candidates comfortable communicating in English, Kannada or other relevant regional languages.
 Students interested in marketing, entrepreneurship, education, business development or community building.
 Previous campus ambassador or marketing experience is not mandatory.
 What Will You Gain? 
 Practical exposure to startup marketing and outreach.
 Experience in community building and campaign execution.
 Mentorship and constructive feedback from the programme team.
 Opportunities to strengthen communication, planning and leadership skills.
 A certificate upon successful completion of the programme requirements.
 Consideration for future projects or extended responsibilities, subject to availability and selection.
 Other Details 
 Duration: 4 weeks initially, with the possibility of extension.
 Work Mode: Primarily remote, with campus activities where feasible and permitted.
 Location: Open to eligible college students across Karnataka.
 Time Commitment: Flexible, with agreed weekly tasks, deadlines and reporting.
 Compensation: Unpaid learning-focused programme.

 Selected ambassadors must use approved brand materials, communicate honestly, respect college rules, avoid unsolicited mass messaging and protect student privacy. Ambassadors must not make unauthorised promises regarding admissions, placements or educational outcomes.

 About the Company 
 RARE is a modern wellness platform reimagining personal rejuvenation and everyday well-being. By integrating curated wellness commerce, sanctuary appointments, on-demand at-home sessions, and intelligent diagnostic experiences, RARE bridges tactile care with seamless technology. We are building an ecosystem designed to bring calm, high-standard wellness rituals directly to individuals and partner networks.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Partner Onboarding & Integration Enablement 
 Guide wellness partners, practitioners, and retail partners through end-to-end technical onboarding onto RARE's portals and APIs.
 Assist partners with data migration, product catalog ingestion, scheduling calendar syncing, and webhook/API configuration.
 Identify onboarding friction points and build automated ingestion pipelines, scripts, or templates to reduce onboarding lead time.
 2. Technical Assistance & Field Operations 
 Serve as the dedicated Tier-2/Tier-3 technical escalation point for partners experiencing operational bugs, inventory syncing issues, or integration errors.
 Troubleshoot API payloads, webhook delivery failures, authentication tokens, and portal configurations.
 Produce clear technical documentation, integration guides, setup checklists, and API recipes tailored for partner teams.
 3. Internal Tooling & Product Feedback Loop 
 Develop lightweight internal tools, dashboards, and automated verification scripts to simplify platform management and system observability.
 Act as the voice of the partner within engineering: document recurring bugs, feature requests, and edge cases to help shape RARE’s core platform roadmap.
 Verify new platform release builds and feature flags against live partner configurations to maintain platform reliability.
 What We Are Looking For 
 Technical Background: Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
 Core Coding Skills: Familiarity with modern programming stacks (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Node.js) and working with RESTful APIs, JSON payloads, and webhooks.
 Data & Tooling Competence: Basic experience with SQL/relational databases, data formatting/manipulation (CSV/JSON scripts), and Git version control.
 Problem-Solving & Empathy: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to deconstruct complex technical problems and explain them simply to non-technical operational stakeholders.
 Ownership Mindset: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment where wearing multiple hats and taking end-to-end ownership is essential.
 What Makes You Stand Out 
 Prior experience with platform integrations, API development, or developer advocacy.
 Exposure to workflow automation tools (e.g., Postman, Retool, Zapier/Make, custom webhook handlers).
 An interest in the intersection of digital health, wellness technology, and scalable platform ecosystems.
 What You’ll Gain 
 Real Production Impact: Direct exposure to live software deployments, partner architecture, and platform scaling.
 Cross-Disciplinary Exposure: Experience working closely across engineering, product design, and strategic partner operations.
 Mentorship & Ownership: Regular mentorship from core founding engineers, with full ownership over your tools and integration workflows.

 Show up in developer communities where agent builders talk: GitHub discussions, Discord and Slack groups, Reddit and forum threads. Answer questions, share what you learned, and be useful first.
 Turn what you hear into input for us: the questions people ask, where they get stuck, and which posts or answers made them curious. 
 Report weekly on what you published, what got a response, and what you would do next.
 Explain complex monitoring, evaluation, reliability, and performance concepts to developers and technical audiences.
 Support developer community engagement through webinars, workshops, social channels, and technical events.
 Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather feedback and improve developer experience.
 Build sample projects and hands-on demonstrations that show practical observability workflows for AI applications. 
 Work directly with the founder and CEO, who reviews your first posts and then gives you room.

 You feel very comfortable in social media and in online developer communities. It comes naturally to you. Strong interest in developer advocacy, artificial intelligence, observability, and technical communication.  You are comfortable posting under your own name and connecting with new people online and on social media platforms.
 You have built at least one LLM or agent project, however small, and can say what broke when you ran it.
 You can explain a technical idea to another developer in plain words. Public writing, talks, videos or open-source work is the best proof.

 Comfort with learning developer tools, APIs, cloud technologies, or monitoring platforms.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with a proactive and collaborative approach. don't apply if you dont have it.

unstop-1777033.body:
About the Company: 
 Godstockss is a stock market analytics platform focused on technology-driven market insights and digital experiences. We aim to build a modern, intuitive, and user-friendly platform that makes market information accessible through well-designed interfaces and analytical tools.
 About the Internship: 
 Godstockss is seeking a motivated Frontend Developer Intern to improve and enhance its existing website. The intern will help build responsive user interfaces, implement modern UI/UX designs, improve website usability, and develop interactive dashboard components using React and related web technologies. This remote, part-time internship offers hands-on experience working on a real-world product, opportunities to strengthen frontend development skills, and the chance to contribute to meaningful website improvements while building a professional portfolio.
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 Develop and improve responsive website interfaces using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Implement UI/UX designs provided by the design team.
 Improve website layouts, navigation, responsiveness, and interactive components.
 Assist in developing and enhancing stock market analytics dashboards.
 Identify and fix frontend bugs and usability issues.
 Test website functionality across different screen sizes and browsers.
 Collaborate with UI/UX designers and other team members.
 Follow clean coding practices and maintain reusable components.
 Use Git and GitHub for version control and project collaboration.
 Explore AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while reviewing and understanding the generated code.
 Requirements: 
 Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
 Familiarity with React or willingness to learn it.
 Understanding of responsive web design and basic UI/UX principles.
 Interest in website development, dashboards, and modern web technologies.
 Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub is preferred.
 Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
 Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and work collaboratively.
 Ability to manage assigned tasks independently in a remote environment.
 A portfolio, GitHub profile, or previous projects are welcome but not mandatory.
 Eligibility :
 Students, freshers, and aspiring frontend developers can apply.
 Candidates from Computer Science, IT, or related backgrounds are welcome; relevant self-taught skills are also valued.
 No prior professional experience is required.
 Applicants should have access to a computer and a reliable internet connection.
 Candidates must be able to commit to the agreed part-time schedule for the six-week internship.
 Applicants should be willing to participate in online coordination and project reviews.
 Internship Details: 
 Duration: 6 Weeks
 Work Mode: Remote / Work From Home
 Work Schedule: Part-time
 Compensation: Unpaid
 Experience: Freshers Welcome
 Openings: 1–2
 Benefits & Certificates: 
 Internship Completion Certificate upon successful completion of the six-week internship and assigned responsibilities.
 Letter of Appreciation based on individual performance, dedication, and contribution.
 Best Frontend Developer Intern Certificate for outstanding performance, subject to evaluation.
 Hands-on experience contributing to a real-world website and analytics platform.
 Practical exposure to React, responsive design, debugging, and collaborative development workflows.
 Opportunities to build portfolio-worthy project experience.
 Feedback and guidance to support technical learning and professional development.
 Note: The Letter of Appreciation and Best Frontend Developer Intern Certificate are performance-based recognitions and are not guaranteed to every intern.
 Selection Process: 
 Application Screening: Review of candidate details, skills, resume, and any available portfolio or GitHub projects.
 Practical Assessment: Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small frontend task involving a responsive webpage or UI component.
 Discussion: Selected candidates may be invited for a brief online discussion about their skills, project decisions, and availability.
 Final Selection: Candidates will be selected based on practical skills, learning ability, communication, and role suitability.
 The practical assessment will be limited in scope and designed to evaluate relevant skills.
 Application Note: 
 We welcome candidates who are eager to learn, build practical skills, and contribute to improving the Godstockss website. If you enjoy frontend development and creating clean, responsive user interfaces, we encourage you to apply.
 Please review the internship details carefully and complete the mandatory application form to receive recruitment updates.

unstop-1782330.body:
About the Role 
 We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to build intelligent systems, AI-powered workflows, and scalable data infrastructure that power next-generation AI products.
 You will work on integrating and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), building automated data pipelines, developing AI-powered information extraction systems, and creating intelligent search and discovery capabilities. Depending on the product requirements, your work may involve model APIs, embeddings, retrieval systems, web crawling, structured data extraction, and AI agents.
 Inspired by modern AI infrastructure platforms such as OpenRouter, you will gain practical experience working with multiple AI models, designing reliable LLM workflows, measuring model performance, and building systems that move beyond experimental notebooks into production applications.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys Python, applied AI, backend engineering, and solving complex technical problems with measurable outcomes.
 Responsibilities 
 Build AI-powered pipelines for data acquisition, processing, enrichment, and automation.
 Integrate and experiment with LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and OpenRouter.
 Develop workflows for structured extraction, classification, summarization, tagging, and information synthesis.
 Build scalable web crawlers and data ingestion pipelines to collect information from websites, APIs, documentation, GitHub, and other public sources.
 Develop systems to discover, organize, and enrich information about AI models, tools, APIs, datasets, research papers, benchmarks, and emerging technologies.
 Implement embedding generation, semantic search, vector retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
 Build and maintain data processing pipelines, validation rules, deduplication, and entity resolution.
 Experiment with model selection, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool calling.
 Design evaluation pipelines to measure model accuracy, relevance, latency, reliability, and cost.
 Implement robust error handling, retries, rate-limit management, caching, and fallback strategies for AI API integrations.
 Develop backend services and APIs that expose AI-powered capabilities to frontend applications.
 Monitor pipeline quality, investigate failures, and improve data freshness and system reliability.
 Research new models, AI frameworks, and infrastructure tools to identify practical improvements.
 Document experiments, technical decisions, and performance benchmarks.
 Requirements 
 Strong proficiency in Python and solid programming fundamentals.
 Understanding of APIs, JSON, HTTP, asynchronous programming, and backend development.
 Hands-on experience building at least one meaningful project using an LLM API or open-source language model.
 Understanding of LLM fundamentals, prompt engineering, tokens, context windows, and structured outputs.
 Familiarity with data processing, web scraping, and data ingestion using tools such as Requests, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, or Scrapy.
 Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, or another database.
 Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
 Understanding of data structures, algorithms, debugging, and writing maintainable code.
 Ability to evaluate technical approaches through experiments rather than relying solely on model outputs or assumptions.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
 A portfolio of AI projects, GitHub repositories, research implementations, or working demos that demonstrate practical engineering ability.
 Good to Have 
 Experience with OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs.
 Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or agent frameworks.
 Experience with embeddings, vector databases such as Qdrant, pgvector, or Pinecone, and RAG pipelines.
 Knowledge of model evaluation, LLM observability, tracing, and experiment tracking.
 Familiarity with MCP, function calling, multi-agent systems, or tool-use workflows.
 Experience with Docker, cloud deployment, Redis, task queues, or workflow orchestration.
 Understanding of model routing, provider fallbacks, latency optimization, token usage, and inference cost optimization.
 Experience with PyTorch, fine-tuning, open-source models, or machine learning fundamentals.
 Who Should Apply? 
 We want engineers who enjoy building and experimenting with real AI systems, not just creating chatbot demos. You should be comfortable reading documentation, testing multiple approaches, measuring results, and turning promising experiments into reliable software.
 Strong Python fundamentals, practical project experience, and the ability to explain your technical decisions are more important than having used every framework listed above.

unstop-1774132.body:
Overview 
 Build real AI developer tools. Work with LLMs, MCP, and open-source engineering. 
 Join Alphashots.AI for a paid, remote technical internship where you will contribute to UnvibeCode, our open-source AI-powered codebase understanding platform. 
 This is a hands-on engineering opportunity to work on emerging AI developer technologies, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenCode integration, LLM-based workflows, and code intelligence systems. 
 You'll work on real engineering problems, contribute to a public GitHub repository, and build practical experience in AI Engineering. 
 Internship Details 
 Position: AI Engineering & Open-Source Development Intern 
 Duration: 1 month 
 Time commitment: 3–5 hours per week 
 Mode: Remote · Flexible 
 Stipend: ₹25,000–₹30,000 fixed per month 
 Eligibility: Engineering students (any stream), MCA/BCA · 2nd year onward 
 Open positions: 1–2 
 What You Will Work On 
 MCP (Model Context Protocol) Development 
 Build and test MCP server capabilities for exposing codebase analysis and developer tools to AI agents. 
 Implement tool interfaces that allow AI assistants to retrieve repository context, workflows, and code relationships. 
 OpenCode & AI Coding Tool Integration 
 Contribute to integrating UnvibeCode with OpenCode and AI-powered coding assistants. 
 Help AI coding agents access relevant code context and understand dependencies across repositories. 
 LLM Engineering & Context Optimization 
 Develop and test LLM-based workflows for code understanding, business workflow discovery, and technical risk analysis. 
 Explore context retrieval, prompt optimization, and techniques to reduce unnecessary LLM token consumption. 
 Python & Open-Source Engineering 
 Implement features, fix bugs, write unit tests, and improve existing Python modules. 
 Work with GitHub issues, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows. 
 Code Intelligence & Repository Analysis 
 Contribute to AST-based code analysis, dependency mapping, and function-level code connections. 
 Test code understanding and repository analysis features against real-world open-source projects. 
 Assignments will be based on project priorities and the intern's technical capabilities. 
 Preferred Technical Skills 
 Programming: Working knowledge of Python and basic debugging. 
 Development tools: Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and pull requests. 
 AI fundamentals: Basic understanding of LLMs, AI agents, APIs, or RAG. 
 Problem-solving: Ability to read unfamiliar code, investigate bugs, and learn new technologies. 
 Prior experience with MCP or OpenCode is not mandatory. We value programming fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn and build.. 
 Beyond the Internship — Rewards for Participants 
 Even if you are not selected for the internship, strong performance in the UnvibeCode Engineering Challenge can earn additional recognition. 
 ₹10,000 total prize pool: Shared equally among the top 4 rankers. 
 Top 10 performers: Recommendation letters based on challenge performance. 
 Top 50 performers: Engineering Challenge participation and achievement certificates. 
 First 100 eligible participants: AI System Design Interview Preparation Pack. 
 What You Will Gain 
 Real-world AI Engineering exposure: Experience with technologies including MCP, LLM integration, AI coding agents, and context engineering. 
 Public GitHub contributions: An opportunity to build verifiable engineering work through open-source pull requests. 
 Practical software engineering experience: Work on real product features, debugging, testing, and code reviews. 
 Technical mentorship: Learn how AI developer tools are designed, built, tested, and improved. 
 Stronger technical profile: Demonstrate hands-on engineering contributions when applying for AI Engineering, Software Engineering, or FDE roles. 
 About Alphashots.AI 
 Alphashots.AI is an IIT–IIM-founded, pre-seed-funded AI technology startup developing applied machine learning solutions and open-source AI developer tools. 
 Our open-source project, UnvibeCode, helps developers and AI coding assistants understand unfamiliar repositories by mapping business workflows, code dependencies, and technical risks.

 A product mindset : you notice why something is frustrating, not just that it broke
 Clear written communication in English
 Your own laptop and a reliable internet connection
 Available for clarification calls in at least one of these windows when needed:
 4:30–7:30 pm IST
 10:30 pm–12:00 am IST
 What you get 
 Hands-on experience with a real, full-lifecycle AI SaaS product before its public launch
 Direct mentorship from the founder
 Cash rewards for the best testers: ₹15,000 for the top tester and about ₹8,000 each for the next four , judged on the quality and impact of findings, not the number filed
 Top performers may be offered a founding full-stack AI engineer role after Phase 1 
 A certificate and a reference for strong contributors

 Apply (details below) with your resume and a 5–7 minute intro video
 Shortlist: 5–15 candidates, contacted by October 17
 30-minute video interview 
 Phase 1 - Product Review/Testing phase (2–4 weeks from October 19), with clear outcome guidelines shared after selection
 Founding roles offered to the top 2–3 engineers after the review phase

unstop-1685517.body:
About Us:
3SVK (3 World Student Villa Key) is an emerging EdTech startup building a high-velocity "technical content engine." We help students master Cybersecurity, AI, and Software Engineering through short, powerful, educational vertical videos. 
 We are currently scouting for our first "Founding Squad"—ambitious student creators who want to master the mechanics of viral tech distribution, build an unignorable professional portfolio, and scale a massive national brand from scratch.
 What You Will Do (Your Role):
- Create Tech Videos: Script, design, and edit high-impact short reels/shorts. You can choose to anchor your focus on Cybersecurity, AI tools, Web Development, or New Tech Trends.
- Consistency Over Volume: We do not value empty volume. We focus on premium curation—delivering one brilliant, highly engaging video every single day that genuinely helps a student learn a core technical skill.
- Extreme Connectivity: We maintain high startup velocity. You just need to maintain active daily communication and reply to team updates on the same day to keep production pipelines moving smoothly.
- Trend Analysis: Research what is trending across the global tech domain and structuralize complex architectural topics into crisp, 60-second "how-to" visual guides.
 Who Can Apply?
- Tool Agnostic: Anyone with a standard phone or laptop. If you know how to operate basic mobile or desktop editing software (CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro, etc.), you are ready.
- All Verticals Welcome: Whether you are pursuing a B.Tech, BCA, BSc, or are simply a passionate tech fan who loves learning and sharing deep knowledge, you have a place here.
- The "Founder" Mindset: We explicitly look for individuals who take absolute ownership. You are not just an intern executing blind tasks; you are actively building the foundation of 3SVK alongside the core product leadership.
 Our Daily Execution & Evaluation Grid (How We Hire):
We maintain high operational velocity. Our evaluation framework runs continuously on a synchronized daily sprint loop:
1. Rapid Resume Screening (Daily): Profiles are evaluated by our product leads immediately upon submission. Selected applicants receive their specialized technical trial modules within 24 hours.
2. The 24-Hour Production Milestone: Once you receive your specific content topic, you will have exactly 24 hours to design, edit, and deliver a 15–20 second vertical technical trial module.
3. Final Roster Locking: Our review loop runs every single evening. Candidates who deliver high-quality visual execution under pressure are cleanly fast-tracked, signed, and integrated directly into our live active Founding Squad communication channels the next morning.
Note: We do not maintain slow, weeks-long corporate wait times. If you apply today, your screening track begins immediately.
 The 3SVK Guarantee (Your Rewards):
- Verified Corporate Credentials: Secure an official Internship Certificate and Experience Letter from 3SVK to massively elevate your professional resume formatting.
- Master SEO & Algorithms: Receive direct, hands-on training on SEO strategies, distribution networks, and retention algorithms used to dominate social media search indexes.
- Future Freelance Priority: High-performing creators gain immediate, priority access to our upcoming paid "Earn-while-you-learn" commercial freelance project modules.
- Direct Executive Mentorship: Work side-by-side with the founders to learn the exact mechanics of system optimization, asset building, and early-stage startup scaling parameters.
 Additional Information:
- Duration: 2-3 Months
- Work Mode: Full-Time / Remote (Work From Home)
- Stipend: Founding Unpaid Learning & Portfolio Execution Track

amazon-10594420.body:
Are you passionate about building automation solutions that transform financial operations at scale? Join Transportation Financial Services (TFS) at Amazon, where you'll develop critical systems that power financial reporting and migrations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll tackle complex challenges in financial data processing, creating automated solutions that enable accurate book closures and seamless migrations.
As a SysDE on the TFS team, you'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve how Amazon manages transportation finances. You'll design device automations for large-scale migrations, build metric-generation systems that provide financial visibility, and create mechanisms that proactively address customer issues. Your work will enable business teams to operate more efficiently while ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of financial operations that support millions of deliveries worldwide.
As an ideal candidate, you have experience in developing automation and operating complex systems in a production environment. You apply system engineering and development practices to ensure your automation is both reliable and correct. Your technical knowledge includes Linux systems and networking.
Key job responsibilities
Design and implement automated solutions for device migrations and financial system transitions, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations
Develop metric generation systems and reporting tools that enable accurate financial book closures and provide visibility into transportation financial operations
Write clean, maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms while considering tradeoffs, limitations, and performance constraints
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues by addressing support tickets, diagnosing system problems, and implementing solutions that improve customer experience
Enhance existing features and build new capabilities that simplify adoption for internal customers and improve the overall reliability of financial systems
You should be able to triage situations quickly and work well with other engineers. We want you to be the best version of yourself – to continuously evolve and improve
About the team
Transportation Financial Services (TFS) is at the heart of Amazon's transportation operations, building the systems that track, report, and analyze financial data across our global delivery network. Our team combines software engineering expertise with financial domain knowledge to create solutions that ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency. We value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, with team members ranging from early-career engineers to seasoned technical leaders.
We're focused on modernizing financial operations through automation and building scalable systems that support Amazon's growing transportation business. Our team culture emphasizes mentorship, continuous learning, and taking calculated approaches to solving complex problems. You'll have opportunities to work on meaningful projects that directly impact business decisions while developing your technical skills in cloud computing, data processing, and financial systems.
- 1+ years of systems development experience
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

unstop-1800995.body:
Overview: 
 Campus Placement Aptitude Challenge 3 is a free, online, individual challenge by CampusFirst India. It has 45 questions on quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability and data interpretation, the kind of questions asked in the online aptitude round of campus placements at TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte and other mass recruiters.
 Please register on our website: www.campusfirstindia.com/compete 
 The competition will take place on our website.
 How It Works: 
 Competition date: Saturday, 14 November 2026 
 Start any time between 7:00 and 9:00 PM IST. Everyone gets the full 30 minutes, whenever they start. 
 45 questions, 30 minutes, one attempt per participant 
 Scoring: each correct answer scores 500 to 1,000 points. The faster you answer correctly, the more points you get. 
 Results at 9:45 PM IST: your score, an all-India leaderboard, and worked solutions for every question 
 What’s Covered: 
 Quantitative aptitude: percentages, profit and loss, ratio and proportion, averages, time and work, speed and distance, simple and compound interest, number systems 
 Logical reasoning: series, coding–decoding, blood relations, directions, seating arrangement, syllogisms, puzzles 
 Verbal ability: reading comprehension, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms and antonyms, para jumbles, fill in the blanks 
 Data interpretation: tables, bar and line graphs, pie charts, caselets 
 Fair for Everyone: 
 One attempt each, enforced by our servers 
 Your time is measured on our side, not on your phone 
 Ties on points are broken by number of correct answers, then by total time taken 
 Recognition: 
 The top 10 receive a certificate of merit
 Who Should Take Part: 
 Final-year and pre-final-year students preparing for campus placements 
 Engineering, BCom, BBA, BCA, BSc and MBA students who want to test their aptitude fundamentals 
 Anyone preparing for the aptitude rounds of off-campus drives and mass-recruiter hiring tests 
 Anyone who wants to check their readiness under real time limits 
 How to Take Part: 
 Register for Campus Placement Aptitude Challenge 3. You’ll get a confirmation email with a calendar invite, and a reminder 30 minutes before the challenge opens. 
 On Saturday, 14 November, sign in and start the challenge any time between 7:00 and 9:00 PM IST. You get the full 30 minutes from when you start. 
 Come back at 9:45 PM IST for your score, the leaderboard and worked solutions. 
 Rules: 
 One account and one attempt per person; multiple accounts lead to disqualification 
 Challenge decisions by CampusFirst India are final 
 Aged 17? Sign up early. A parent or guardian must confirm by email before you can register.

unstop-1801734.body:
Volopay is hiring for Talent Acquisition Intern 
 About the Company 
 Volopay is building its team in the fintech sector and is offering a hands-on opportunity for someone curious about how strong teams are formed. As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you will work alongside the People & Talent team and contribute to genuine hiring initiatives while developing practical recruitment skills.
 Responsibilities 
 Source prospective candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and other channels.
 Review applications and assess how candidate backgrounds align with role requirements.
 Contact candidates, hold initial conversations, share updates, and follow up throughout the process.
 Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers and help ensure a smooth candidate experience.
 Support screening calls, assignment evaluations, interview preparation, and related hiring activities.
 Maintain candidate records and recruitment trackers, and assist with campus outreach and early-career hiring.
 Requirements 
 Zero to one year of experience; fresh graduates and people beginning a career in HR are welcome.
 Clear communication and interpersonal skills, strong organisation, and attention to detail.
 Ability to manage multiple tasks, follow up consistently, and meet timelines.
 A proactive approach, curiosity about recruitment and talent management, and willingness to take ownership.
 Familiarity with LinkedIn, Google Sheets, or similar productivity tools is an advantage.
 This is a six-month, full-time, paid internship based in Bangalore, with a stipend of ₹10,000 per month, based on performance. The intern will gain exposure to sourcing, screening, interview coordination, campus hiring, and hiring operations while working with hiring managers. Based on internship performance and business requirements, there may be an opportunity to transition into a full-time role with an annual CTC of ₹3,00,000.

unstop-1801480.body:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
 Are you ambitious, confident and interested in sales, business development and customer counselling?
 Quraaniq is looking for motivated, enthusiastic and result-oriented individuals to join our Sales & Business Development team.
 We welcome both freshers and experienced candidates who want to gain practical experience in sales, education counselling, lead management and customer acquisition.
 This 45-day internship provides an opportunity to work with a growing EdTech startup, interact with prospective parents, generate business and develop professional sales skills.
 EARN 20% OF ELIGIBLE REVENUE GENERATED THROUGH YOUR SUCCESSFUL STUDENT ENROLMENTS! 
 There is no fixed monthly stipend during the internship. Your earnings will be entirely performance-based, depending on successful sales and eligible revenue generated.
 High-performing candidates may also be considered for paid employment opportunities with Quraaniq after successful completion of the internship.
 ABOUT QURAANIQ
 Quraaniq is an online Quran and Islamic education platform dedicated to making quality Islamic learning accessible to children and adults.
 We provide personalised one-to-one online Quran classes through trained teachers, with structured programmes in Noorani Qaida, Quran Reading, Tajweed, Masnoon Duas and essential Islamic education.
 As a growing education startup, we are building a learner-focused ecosystem that combines personal attention, structured learning, progress tracking and technology.
 WHY SHOULD YOU APPLY?
 20% Revenue-Based Incentives: Earn 20% of eligible revenue generated through your successful student enrolments.
 Potential Earnings of INR 10,000+: Opportunity to earn additional incentives depending on your sales performance.
 Work From Home: Work remotely from anywhere in India.
 Practical Sales Experience: Learn real-world sales, counselling and customer acquisition.
