unstop-1803129.body:
Name: Claude Quiz India 2026
 Theme: Prove your AI skills before recruiters ask
 Three rounds. Bronze, Silver, Gold. One free national quiz for college students, with a verifiable certificate, recommendation letters and career reviews worth up to ₹10,999.
 About the event 
 Most freshers list “AI tools” on their resume. Few can show they use them well.
 Claude Quiz India 2026 tests that skill in three rounds. It starts with the basics of prompting and moves to real work scenarios: improving a resume, preparing for an interview, spotting a wrong AI answer and handling confidential data.
 Everyone who takes part gets a certificate with a unique ID that anyone can verify online. Top scorers get a national rank, a recommendation letter and one-on-one career support.
 It is free, open to every stream and year, and needs no prior AI experience.
 Claude Quiz India 2026 is an independent quiz run by a registered non-profit. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. 
 What to expect 
 Time: About 2 hours in total across three rounds (60 + 30 + 30 minutes).
 Format: Online, on any device, individual participation.
 Questions: Real situations, not trivia. You will improve a weak prompt, pick the safest way to handle a document, decide whether an AI answer is reliable and write a prompt of your own. Round 3 includes short written answers.
 Scoring: No negative marking. There is no cut-off, so every participant moves on to the next round.
 What you take away: A verifiable certificate, a clear view of your AI skill level and a result you can add to your resume and LinkedIn.
 The 3 rounds 
 Round 
 Level 
 Questions 
 Marks 
 Time 
 What it tests 
 Round 1 
 Bronze (Easy) 
 60 
 2 each (120) 
 60 min 
 AI basics, clear prompts, safe use 
 Round 2 
 Silver (Medium) 
 30 
 2 each (60) 
 30 min 
 Better prompts, career tasks, checking AI answers 
 Round 3 
 Gold (Hard) 
 10 
 10 each (100) 
 30 min 
 Judgment in real scenarios, plus written answers 
 Rules 
 Play the rounds in order. Round 2 opens after you finish Round 1, and Round 3 opens after you finish Round 2.

unstop-1801847.body:
About Opal Code: 
 At Opal Code, we believe data holds the key to smarter decisions and meaningful innovation. We work at the intersection of technology, analytics, and software development, creating solutions that address practical business challenges.
 We are looking for aspiring Data Science Interns who enjoy exploring data, experimenting with algorithms, and turning raw information into actionable insights. This internship offers an opportunity to apply your technical knowledge while contributing to hands-on project work.
 Internship Overview: 
 Role: Data Science Intern
 Organization: Opal Code
 Duration: 2 Months
 Work Mode: Remote
 Stipend: ₹15,000 per month
 Eligibility: Freshers, students, and experienced candidates
 Roles And Responsibilities: 
 Translate business or analytical questions into data science tasks.
 Work with Python-based tools to process and analyze datasets.
 Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering.
 Implement suitable machine learning algorithms.
 Validate models using appropriate performance metrics.
 Document project workflows, methodologies, and results.
 Collaborate with mentors and incorporate technical feedback.
 Complete project milestones within the assigned timelines.
 What You'll Work On: 
 As a Data Science Intern, you will participate in analytical and machine learning tasks that involve understanding datasets, discovering patterns, building predictive models, and communicating insights.
 Your work will involve:
 Exploring real-world datasets to uncover meaningful trends and relationships.
 Preparing datasets by handling missing values, inconsistencies, and outliers.
 Applying statistical methods to support data-driven analysis.
 Developing machine learning models for prediction and classification tasks.
 Evaluating model performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.
 Presenting analytical findings through visualizations and structured reports.
 Sample Projects: 
 During the internship, you may work on projects such as:
 Customer Churn Prediction: 
 Build a machine learning model to identify customers who are likely to discontinue a service.
 Sales Forecasting System: 
 Analyze historical sales data and develop forecasting models to estimate future sales trends.
 Movie Recommendation Engine: 
 Create a recommendation system that suggests movies based on user preferences and viewing patterns.
 Credit Risk Analysis: 
 Explore financial datasets and develop models to assess potential credit default risk.
 Student Performance Prediction: 
 Use academic and behavioral data to analyze factors influencing student performance and predict outcomes.
 E-Commerce Customer Segmentation: 
 Apply clustering techniques to group customers based on purchasing behavior and business-relevant attributes.
 Project assignments may vary depending on the internship track and individual progress.
 Skills & Technical Background: 
 Candidates with familiarity in the following areas will have an advantage:
 Python programming
 Pandas and NumPy
 Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar visualization libraries
 Statistics and probability fundamentals
 Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
 Machine Learning fundamentals
 Scikit-learn
 SQL and database basics
 Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they are still developing their technical expertise, provided they demonstrate a genuine interest in Data Science.
 Who Should Apply?: 
 Students pursuing degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related disciplines.
 Recent graduates looking to strengthen their technical portfolio.
 Individuals interested in machine learning and data-driven problem solving.
 Candidates seeking practical exposure through project-based work.
 What You Can Gain: 
 Practical experience with Data Science workflows.
 Exposure to machine learning implementation and evaluation.
 Project experience that can strengthen your technical portfolio.
 Internship completion certificate for eligible candidates.
 Letter of Recommendation for eligible high-performing interns.
 Career and resume-building guidance.

This could involve tasks such as checking and/or fixing metadata, image, subtitles, audio and video assets to provide a seamless viewing experience to PV customers. The day to day job requires the individual to make judgment based decisions by following a standard operating procedure. The associate should have working knowledge of MS office to capture data on daily basis.
About the team
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, Sports, and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.

unstop-1794884.body:
BUILDSprint 2026–28 | Solo Hiring Hackathon
 Presented by WorkElate
 Build. Solve. Ship. Get noticed. 
 Are you ready to showcase your technical skills, solve real-world problems and compete for exciting career opportunities?
 WorkElate presents BuildSprint 2026–28 , a solo hiring hackathon designed to identify emerging software engineering talent through technical assessments, problem-solving, screening and an overnight coding challenge.
 This is your opportunity to demonstrate your engineering mindset, creativity, technical knowledge and ability to turn ideas into practical solutions.
 Compete individually. Win cash prizes. Get considered for internship and full-time career opportunities. 
 Event Highlights
 Format: Hybrid – Online + Offline
 Participation: Individual only
 Selection Rounds: 4
 Maximum Finalists: 12
 Event Launch: 8 November 2026
 Grand Finale: 18–19 November 2026
 Final Venue: WorkElate Office, Hyderabad
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Open to candidates pursuing or graduating from:
 Degrees: B.Tech and BCA
 Branches: Computer Science, Information Technology and relevant CS specializations.
 Graduation Years: 2026, 2027 and 2028.
 Relevant specializations include AI/ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity and other computing-related disciplines.
 Note: Individual participation only. Team registrations are not allowed.
 Competition Structure – 4 Rounds
 Round 1 – Online Technical Quiz 
 An online timed quiz to evaluate your technical fundamentals and problem-solving abilities.
 Topics may include: 
 Programming fundamentals and logical reasoning
 Data structures and algorithms
 Full-stack development concepts
 APIs, databases and system-design basics
 AI-assisted coding and prompt engineering
 Round 2 – 48-Hour Problem Statement Challenge 
 Qualified candidates will receive a problem statement document from WorkElate.
 You will have 48 hours (2 days) to understand the problem and submit a proposal explaining your approach and proposed solution.
 Your submission will be evaluated on:
 Understanding of the problem
 Creativity and originality
 Technical reasoning
 Feasibility of the proposed solution
 Implementation approach and planning
 Clarity of presentation
 Important: This round focuses on your proposed solution and approach, not a fully developed application, unless specifically required in the problem statement instructions.
 Round 3 – Screening Round 
 Shortlisted candidates will participate in a screening discussion with the WorkElate team.
 The screening will focus on:
 Understanding of your Round 2 submission
 Technical knowledge and reasoning
 Problem-solving approach
 Communication and explanation skills
 Ownership of your proposed solution
 The best-performing candidates will advance to the final round.
 Round 4 – Offline Solo Hackathon | Grand Finale 
 Up to 12 shortlisted candidates will participate in an overnight individual hackathon at WorkElate's Hyderabad office.
 A fresh problem statement will be provided at the venue. Participants must independently develop and demonstrate their solutions within the allotted time.
 Final Schedule: 
 Starts: 18 November 2026, 4:00 PM
 Ends: 19 November 2026, 7:00 AM
 Duration: 15 hours
 Venue: WorkElate Office, Hyderabad
 The final evaluation will consider problem understanding, functionality, engineering implementation, system-design decisions, code quality, testing and project demonstration.
 Prizes & Internship Opportunities
 Position 
 Cash Prize 
 Internship 
 1st Prize 
 ₹20,000 
 6-month internship 
 2nd Prize 
 ₹10,000 
 6-month internship 
 3rd Prize 
 ₹5,000 
 6-month internship 
 Internship stipend: Proposed at ₹10,000 per month for six months, subject to the final internship offer and company terms.
 Additional Opportunity: The first-place winner may be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) of up to ₹12 LPA , subject to performance, role availability and company requirements. This is not a guaranteed offer.
 Other exceptional candidates may also be considered for internship opportunities based on performance and hiring requirements.
 Skills We Are Looking For 
 Programming and problem-solving
 Full-stack development fundamentals
 Frontend and backend concepts
 APIs and database management
 System-design fundamentals
 Software engineering practices
 AI coding assistants and prompt engineering
 Agentic AI development workflows
 Candidates may use their preferred programming languages and technology stacks. We value problem-solving ability, technical understanding and engineering decisions over familiarity with one particular framework.

Overview 
 Physics Wallah (PW) is looking for a motivated, enthusiastic, and result-oriented Admission Counsellor to join our team in Balasore.
 The candidate will be responsible for interacting with students and parents, understanding their educational requirements, explaining PW courses and programs, and guiding them through the admission process. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and convincing skills, a positive attitude, and an interest in the education sector.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Interact with prospective students and parents through walk-ins, phone calls, and other communication channels.
 Understand students' academic goals and recommend suitable courses and programs.
 Explain course details, fee structures, batch schedules, and admission procedures.
 Follow up with interested students and parents to convert enquiries into admissions.
 Handle student queries and resolve concerns professionally.
 Achieve monthly admission and sales targets.
 Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow-ups, and admissions.
 Build strong relationships with students and parents.
 Coordinate with the academic and operations teams to ensure a smooth admission experience.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
 Strong convincing, negotiation, and customer-handling abilities.
 Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Excel or Google Sheets.
 Ability to handle multiple enquiries and follow up effectively.
 Target-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn.
 Prior experience in sales, counselling, customer support, or education is preferred.
 Freshers with good communication and sales skills are welcome to apply.
 What We Offer 
 Opportunity to work with a leading education company.
 Professional learning and career growth opportunities.
 Supportive and collaborative work environment.
 Performance-based incentives

unstop-1804030.body:
About: 
 We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented and energetic Business Development Executive to drive the adoption of ICXBee , our customer feedback and survey platform, across QSRs, restaurants, cafes and food service businesses.
 This is a field-intensive, B2B sales role that requires the candidate to proactively visit restaurants, interact with restaurant managers, owners and decision-makers, demonstrate the ICXBee platform and convert prospects into paying customers.
 The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential QSR outlets, conducting product demonstrations, explaining the business benefits of replacing traditional Google-based QR feedback systems with ICXBee, and closing new business opportunities.
 We are looking for someone who can open doors, pitch confidently, demonstrate value and close deals – not someone who only generates leads from a desk 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Field Sales & Customer Acquisition: 
 Proactively visit QSRs, restaurants, cafes, food courts and restaurant chains to identify business opportunities.
 Walk into outlets, introduce ICXBee and initiate conversations with restaurant owners, outlet managers and operations heads.
 Identify the existing customer feedback collection methods used by restaurants.
 Pitch ICXBee as a more structured and business-oriented alternative to traditional Google Forms and basic QR-based feedback solutions.
 Generate leads, conduct product demonstrations and convert prospects into customers.
 Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through regular field visits and follow-ups.
 Product Demonstration & Solution Selling: 
 Demonstrate the ICXBee platform to prospective customers using a mobile phone, tablet or laptop.
 Explain how QR-based feedback and surveys can help restaurants understand customer satisfaction and identify service improvement opportunities.
 Communicate the value of centralized feedback collection, structured surveys, actionable insights and reporting (based on available ICXBee features).
 Help prospects understand how ICXBee can fit into their existing restaurant operations.
 Clearly differentiate ICXBee from free or basic Google-based feedback collection methods.
 Business Development & Revenue Generation: 
 Achieve monthly sales, revenue and customer acquisition targets.
 Identify opportunities within individual outlets as well as multi-outlet and restaurant chain accounts.
 Build relationships with restaurant owners, franchise operators, regional managers and corporate decision-makers.
 Negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing guidelines.
 Drive closures and ensure timely onboarding of newly acquired customers.
 Customer Relationship Management: 
 Coordinate with the onboarding and customer success teams to ensure smooth implementation.
 Follow up with customers after onboarding to encourage product adoption.
 Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities wherever applicable.
 Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, sales visits, demos and closures in the CRM.
 Required Skills & Competencies: 
 Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills.
 Strong confidence in approaching unknown people and initiating business conversations.

unstop-1803882.body:
Job Overview 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically proficient ERP & Inventory Data Coordinator to manage inventory records, shipping data, ERP entries, and operational reporting for our manufacturing operations.
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with MS Excel and Google Sheets, the ability to manage large volumes of data, and a good understanding of inventory management, stock movement, shipping, and dispatch operations
 Key Responsibilities 
 Enter daily production output, raw material consumption, and work order updates into the ERP system.
 Maintain accurate records of production batches, batch numbers, cards, and production variances.
 Update production progress and maintain records of completed and pending work orders.
 Maintain product information, item codes, quantities, and warehouse location details in ERP.
 Create and maintain master Excel sheets and Google Sheets for inventory, shipping, and operational records.
 Handle large datasets, including 800–1,000+ rows of information.
 Work with PivotTables, filters, sorting, conditional formatting, and data validation.
 Consolidate information from multiple spreadsheets into a single master report.
 Generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports as required by management.
 Inventory Management & Stock Tracking 
 Record and update Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), stock issues, and stock transfers in the ERP system.
 Maintain records of incoming raw materials, outgoing materials, finished goods, and available inventory.
 Track raw material consumption against production requirements.
 Perform stock reconciliation and support regular physical stock verification and cycle counts.
 Shipping & Dispatch Coordination 
 Maintain shipping, dispatch, and delivery tracking records.
 Update shipment details, tracking numbers, dispatch dates, quantities, and delivery status.
 Coordinate with logistics teams, transporters, vendors, and internal departments to collect shipping information.
 Communication & Reporting Coordination 
 Respond to data and reporting requests from managers and other departments.
 Collect missing information and follow up with relevant teams and vendors.
 Prepare and share accurate reports within the required timelines.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field.
 2–4 years of relevant experience in ERP data management, MIS reporting, inventory coordination, or operations.
 Strong hands-on knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
 Good understanding of inventory management, stock tracking, shipping, and dispatch processes.
 Ability to handle and consolidate large volumes of data.
 Knowledge of Excel formulas, PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, and data validation.

unstop-1803735.body:
Frontend Developer Intern 
 Frontend Arena | 3-Month Internship | Remote 
 About Frontend Arena
 Frontend Arena is a growing technology and developer community focused on building innovative digital experiences, organizing hackathons, promoting open-source contributions, and creating opportunities for aspiring developers.
 We are looking for a passionate and motivated Frontend Developer Intern who enjoys building modern, responsive, and interactive web applications.
 As an intern, you will collaborate with our development team, contribute to real-world projects, and gain practical experience working with modern frontend technologies.
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
 Build reusable and maintainable UI components.
 Convert UI/UX designs and Figma prototypes into functional web pages.
 Work with modern JavaScript frameworks and frontend technologies.
 Integrate REST APIs and handle dynamic application data.
 Optimize website performance, accessibility, and responsiveness.
 Identify, debug, and resolve frontend issues.
 Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other team members.
 Participate in code reviews and maintain clean coding practices.
 Contribute to Frontend Arena's internal projects and open-source initiatives.
 Required Skills 
 Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
 Familiarity with React.js.
 Understanding of responsive web design.
 Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
 Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON.
 Understanding of component-based architecture.
 Problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.
 Preferred Skills 
 TypeScript
 Next.js
 Tailwind CSS
 React Router
 Vite
 Basic understanding of frontend performance optimization.
 Internship Details 
 Position: Frontend Developer Intern
 Organization: Frontend Arena
 Duration: 3 Months
 Work Mode: Remote
 Employment Type: Internship
 Experience Level: Beginner / Intermediate
 Open To: Students, Freshers, and Aspiring Developers
 What You Will Gain 
 Hands-on experience with real-world development projects.
 Opportunity to work with modern frontend technologies.
 Practical experience with GitHub and collaborative development workflows.
 Exposure to professional development practices and code reviews.
 Opportunity to contribute to open-source projects.
 Portfolio-building experience through practical contributions.
 Internship Certificate upon successful completion, subject to completion criteria.
 Potential opportunity for extended collaboration based on performance and organizational requirements.
 Who Should Apply? 
 We welcome students, freshers, and aspiring frontend developers who are enthusiastic about web development, enjoy building things, and are eager to learn through practical experience.
 You don't need to know every technology listed. We value problem-solving abilities, consistency, willingness to learn, and genuine interest in development.
 Ready to Build Something Meaningful?
 Join Frontend Arena, collaborate with passionate developers, and turn your ideas into real-world digital experiences.
 Build. Collaborate. Innovate.

unstop-1803891.body:
About Codeatrix 
 Codeatrix is an IT company focused on technology-driven solutions, software development, and industry-oriented projects across various business domains. We work with modern technologies, including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data-driven solutions, to solve business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
 Internship Details 
 Role: AI/ML Intern
 Industry: IT / Software Development
 Work Mode: Remote / Work From Home
 Duration: 2 Months
 Stipend: ₹15,000- ₹20000 per month
 Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates can apply
 Job Description 
 Codeatrix is looking for motivated AI/ML Interns to work on industry-oriented projects involving Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data-driven solutions. Interns will work with datasets, develop machine learning models, evaluate results, and explore AI technologies to solve practical business and technical challenges.
 Day-to-Day Roles and Responsibilities 
 Work on AI/ML projects involving industry-relevant problems and datasets.
 Clean, preprocess, and analyze data using Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
 Implement supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms.
 Train, test, evaluate, and optimize models using appropriate techniques and performance metrics.
 Explore Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), or computer vision based on project requirements.
 Document findings, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with the team to improve project outcomes.
 Who Can Apply? 
 College students from any year, freshers, recent graduates, and experienced candidates.
 Candidates from Computer Science, IT, AI, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields are preferred.
 Candidates from other academic backgrounds with an interest in AI/ML are also welcome.
 Applicants should have analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.
 Preferred Skills 
 Basic knowledge of Python and programming fundamentals.
 Familiarity with machine learning, statistics, or data analysis.
 Knowledge of Pandas, NumPy, or Scikit-learn is an advantage.
 Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jupyter Notebook, or Google Colab is beneficial.
 Prior academic or personal projects are welcome but not mandatory.
 Selection Process 
 Application screening based on qualifications and relevant skills.
 Technical assessment or discussion, where applicable.
 Interaction with the team for shortlisted candidates.
 Selected candidates receive onboarding instructions and project details.
 How to Apply 
 Interested candidates can apply through the internship application portal by providing accurate details about their education, technical skills, projects, and prior experience, if applicable.
 Join Codeatrix to gain experience working on technology-driven projects in the evolving field of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

unstop-1806100.body:
About the Company 
 HayCod solutions is an AI-first technology company working across IT services, EdTech, and career development. The team supports learners and organizations through career-oriented programs and technology solutions. This Sales Executive role offers the opportunity to introduce those offerings to prospective customers and contribute directly to business growth.
 Responsibilities 
 Generate and qualify leads through calling, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, social channels, and other appropriate outreach.
 Engage students, parents, institutions, and corporate prospects to understand their needs and present relevant courses, career programs, training, or IT services.
 Explain program structures, service offerings, benefits, and career opportunities clearly, then guide interested prospects through decisions and enrollment.
 Maintain consistent follow-ups, negotiate effectively, convert qualified leads, and build lasting customer and partner relationships.
 Work toward monthly sales targets, coordinate customer onboarding with internal teams, and maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, and pipeline data.
 Requirements 
 Excellent verbal communication, interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
 A target-oriented mindset, confidence in lead generation and conversion, and an interest in EdTech, education sales, career development, or IT services.
 Basic familiarity with LinkedIn, CRM tools, and digital communication channels is useful.
 Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude are welcome; prior experience in EdTech, career program sales, or IT services sales is an advantage.
 This is a full-time, in-office opportunity based in Bengaluru, with monthly compensation of ₹20,000–₹60,000. The role includes performance-based incentives, growth opportunities, and professional development and learning opportunities.

unstop-1805744.body:
Business Development Associate (Full-Time) 
 We are hiring a Growth Strategist – Hunter to open new accounts for Talverge. You will be responsible for finding, calling, and converting recruitment firms and mid-market hiring teams into paying customers.
 Role Details 
 Role: Growth Strategist – Hunter
 Company: SolvusAI Technologies (Product: Talverge)
 Experience: 1–2 years in B2B SaaS Sales
 Location: Remote
 Reports To: Chief Revenue Officer
 Employment Type: Full-time, individual contributor with a quota
 About Talverge 
 Talverge, from SolvusAI, is an AI-native talent intelligence platform. It helps recruitment teams submit qualified candidates faster by automating resume screening and first-round interviews.
 AI-Video and AI-Audio Interviews: Candidates can complete interviews anytime, on any device, with proctoring to ensure fairness.
 Scored Assessment Reports: Consolidated score sheets help recruiters shortlist candidates in minutes.
 WhatsApp Integration: Along with a zero-trust security model.
 We are an early-stage, bootstrapped company building our customer base. You will be among the first few members of the Sales team, working directly with the CRO, and your results will shape how we sell.
 What You Will Do 
 Prospect Every Day: Build target lists of recruitment consultancies, staffing firms, and mid-market companies using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, job-board signals, and your own research.
 Make Cold Calls and Send Cold Emails: Run multi-touch outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn to reach Talent Acquisition Heads, CHROs, and founders.
 Separate genuine opportunities from general interest so that only qualified deals enter the funnel.
 Run Discovery: Uncover prospects' hiring challenges, such as fake resumes and recruiter overload, and quantify their impact.
 Manage Deals: Identify the champion, economic buyer, decision-making process, and competition for every opportunity. Review deals weekly with the CRO.
 Book and Run Demos and Pilots: Set up product walkthroughs and paid pilots, agree on success criteria, and convert pilots into annual subscriptions.
 Keep the CRM Accurate: Log every interaction, update deal stages, and report funnel performance and conversions each week.
 Share Feedback: Communicate objections, competitor intelligence, and product requests to the team.
 What You Need 
 B2B SaaS Sales Experience Mandatory: Up to 2 years of experience in an SDR, BDR, inside sales, or business development role at a SaaS company. Strong sales internships count.
 A Hunter Mindset: Enjoy opening new accounts, stay persistent through rejection, and measure your performance through meetings booked and deals won.
 Prospecting and Cold Calling: Comfortable making high-volume cold calls and writing short, personalised cold emails that generate responses.
 Sales Frameworks: Working knowledge of BANT, SPIN, and MEDDPICC, with the discipline to apply them during real calls.
 Clear Communication: Confident and concise spoken and written English. Hindi or Kannada is an advantage.
 CRM Discipline: Experience maintaining a CRM, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho CRM.
 Comfortable working in an early-stage company with targets, limited structure, and a fast-changing environment.
 Good to Have 
 Experience selling to HR, Talent Acquisition, or recruitment teams, or selling HR technology.
 Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and an email sequencing tool.
 Exposure to conducting product demos or paid pilots.
 An existing network among recruitment consultancies in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mumbai, or Delhi NCR.
 What We Offer 
 Compensation: INR 3–3.6 lakhs per annum, plus uncapped variable pay linked to ARR, with accelerators above target.
 Direct Mentorship: Guidance from the CRO on prospecting, discovery, and closing using BANT, SPIN, and MEDDPICC.
 A Real Seat at the Table: An opportunity to contribute to an early-stage AI company, with room to grow into a senior sales role as the team expands.
 A Product People Need: Help recruiters stop screening and start hiring.
 Note: Candidates must have 1–2 years of proven experience in B2B SaaS sales to be considered for this role. Freshers need not apply.

 Complete Website UI/UX Redesign: Evaluate the existing Rewyoo website and propose a comprehensive redesign to improve visual appeal, usability, and user engagement.

 Homepage Transformation: Redesign the homepage with improved navigation, content hierarchy, visual storytelling, and prominent calls to action.
 Student and Professional Interfaces: Design dedicated user experiences for students and working professionals, ensuring intuitive navigation and relevant content discovery.
 School and College Pages: Improve the design and presentation of educational institution profiles, reviews, ratings, and related information.
 User Registration Experience: Simplify signup, login, profile creation, and onboarding journeys to improve registration conversion rates.
 Mobile-First Design: Ensure all proposed designs are responsive and optimized for mobile phones, tablets, and desktops.
 Design System Development: Establish consistent typography, colours, buttons, icons, cards, layouts, and reusable UI components while maintaining Rewyoo's orange-and-white brand identity.
 Wireframing and Prototyping: Develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma or equivalent design tools.
 User Experience Optimization: Identify usability issues, improve navigation, reduce unnecessary steps, and recommend improvements to the overall user journey.
 Competitor and Market Research: Analyse leading digital platforms to identify modern UI/UX practices and opportunities to differentiate Rewyoo.
 Developer Collaboration: Work with the development team to ensure approved designs are implemented accurately without affecting existing website functionality.
 Testing and Continuous Improvement: Collect feedback, conduct basic usability testing, and recommend improvements based on user behaviour.
 Required Skills 
 Good understanding of UI/UX design principles.
 Familiarity with Figma, wireframing, and prototyping.
 Understanding of responsive web design.
 Creative thinking and attention to detail.
 Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or frontend development is an advantage.
 Ability to work independently and meet agreed timelines.
 Strong interest in designing modern digital products.
 Expected Deliverables 
 Month 1: Research and Design Foundation 
 Complete UI/UX audit of the existing website.
 Competitor benchmarking and user journey analysis.
 Redesigned landing page and homepage.
 Initial design system and reusable components.
 Month 2: Complete Website Redesign 
 Student and professional landing pages.
 School, college, and company profile pages.
 Registration, login, and onboarding screens.
 Reviews, ratings, and user profile interfaces.
 Responsive desktop and mobile designs.
 Month 3: Implementation Support and Optimization 
 Finalize interactive Figma prototypes.
 Prepare developer-ready design specifications.
 Support frontend implementation.
 Conduct usability testing and recommend improvements.
 What You Will Gain: 
 Opportunity to contribute to the complete redesign of a growing digital platform.
 Hands-on experience working on a live product.
 Practical exposure to product design, UX research, and website optimization.
 Portfolio-worthy design projects.
 Internship completion certificate based on satisfactory performance.
 Opportunity to collaborate directly with the founding team.
 Our Objective: 
 To transform Rewyoo into a premium, modern, and intuitive digital platform that delivers an exceptional experience for students, professionals, educational institutions, and businesses.

unstop-1805961.body:
Ubisar is a global technology and data advisory firm helping companies and investors streamline operations, optimise workflows and unlock AI-driven value. We specialise in process and workflow optimisation, data infrastructure and insights, and applied AI and tech enablement.
 Ubisar is part of the Lanmea ecosystem. Lanmea is a modern value creation and investment platform. Our ecosystem combines global advisory firms with an investment platform, giving you exposure across sectors, stages and geographies. As an intern, you will work at the intersection of that ecosystem: close to real technology, data and AI challenges, workflow and systems modernisation, and investor-backed transformation projects.
 Why we need you 
 Our clients come to us with messy systems, disconnected data and ambitious ideas. They want to modernise operations, build better internal tools and turn AI from buzzword into real business value, without building a large in-house engineering team.
 As a Tech Intern, you help make that happen. You will sit at the intersection of product, data and engineering: mapping real-world workflows, turning them into robust software, and helping our team deliver tangible results for companies and investors across sectors like professional services, financial services, private equity, consumer and retail, healthcare and more.
 The bar is high: we are looking for people who are deeply motivated to build software that solves real business problems, care about robustness and maintainability, and are confident in taking ownership of visible, client-facing work early in their career.
 Why should you join us? 
 Work with colleagues and clients across multiple countries, building experience across diverse industries.
 Ship real solutions used in live client environments, from internal tools and dashboards to AI-enabled workflows and external software tools.
 Plug into the Lanmea ecosystem, giving you exposure to other areas of value creation and to fellow advisors at the intersection of finance, marketing, tech, sustainability and investments.
 Get hands-on exposure to digital transformation, data platforms, AI use cases and modern engineering practices while working alongside experienced advisors and builders.
 Grow quickly through close mentorship and increasing ownership of features, solutions and client workstreams as you develop.
 This is a full-time, paid, remote internship based in India, with a monthly stipend of INR 30,000.
 What you will be doing 
 You will be diving deep into the world of technology, data and AI, turning real business problems into working software. From day one, you will be involved across the full lifecycle, from understanding client workflows to designing, building and shipping solutions, and you will work closely with senior team members on live advisory projects. Specifically, you will:
 Support the team in mapping out client business processes and building custom software solutions and internal tools.
 Support in evaluating tools, platforms and architectures for client recommendations.
 Help create presentation materials and tech solution outlines for clients.
 Help us build full-stack tech and data solutions for our client engagements.
 Support us with the commercial aspects of an advisory business, including case studies, proposals and thought-leadership content on tech, data and AI.
 What we are looking for 
 You hold or are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or you can show equivalent practical experience.
 Exceptionally strong internships and project experience can be considered if you can demonstrate real ownership and impact.
 You are comfortable with modern web and mobile frameworks, both front-end and back-end.
 Experience with LLMs, RAG systems, AI agents, workflow automation, vector databases, or open-source AI tools such as OpenClaw is a strong plus.
 You enjoy solving real-world business problems with technology, not just writing code in isolation.
 You are comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment and communicating clearly with a distributed team.
 You take ownership of your work, ask good questions, and are willing to go one or two layers deeper than what was asked when needed.
 If you are excited about building practical, production-grade software, curious about data and AI, and want to work inside a broader Lanmea ecosystem of ambitious builders, we would love to hear from you.

amazon-10592075.body:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
• Act as the primary point of contact between Amazon's internal teams and North America (NA) business customers to validate and confirm accurate address and location details.
• Apply a strong eye for detail to research, verify, and update correct address and geo-coordinate information in Geo Studio.
• Process a high volume of Address ID's within defined time windows while consistently maintaining a quality bar of 98% or higher.
• Communicate fluently and confidently in English (verbal and written) when speaking with NA business customers to resolve address discrepancies.
• Identify patterns in flagged Address ID's (e.g., incorrect pins, missing business hours, vacant locations) and escalate data gaps to the relevant teams.
• Use internal tools (Geo Studio, SIM, Connect) to research, validate, and correct address and location data.
• Track personal productivity and quality metrics daily; consistently meet Address ID handling volume and accuracy targets.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to reduce recurring address errors and improve overall data quality.
• Provide real-time support in a 24/7 operating environment, working across rotational shifts.
- • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; comfortable speaking directly with North America based business customers.
- • Strong attention to detail with the ability to research and validate data accurately.
- • Working knowledge of Excel and basic data analysis tools.
- • Ability to work in a fast-paced, metric-driven, 24/7 shift-based environment.
- • Ability to consistently meet productivity (Address ID volume) and quality (98%+) targets within defined time windows.
- • Familiarity with Geo Studio, SIM, or similar Amazon internal tools.
- • Experience working directly with external or business customers over phone or email.
- • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP) and exposure to QuickSight.

Beyond tactical problem-solving, N
amazon-10576795.body:
Network Operations Center (NOC) – Overview
The Network Operations Center (NOC) serves as the central command and control hub for Transportation Execution across Amazon's Supply Chain network, spanning multiple geographies including North America, India, and the EU.
NOC is responsible for ensuring the seamless, on-time movement of freight — from vendor pick-ups to Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs. When exceptions arise, NOC takes swift ownership of resolution while keeping all relevant stakeholders informed throughout the process.
Beyond tactical problem-solving, NOC is also entrusted with a strategic mandate: identifying trends in network exceptions, driving process automation, and recommending operational improvements to streamline transportation workflows. This requires continuous network monitoring and in-depth analysis of network data.
In essence, NOC plays a pivotal role in the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network — directly influencing Amazon's ability to deliver on its promise to customers.
Role of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC acts as a critical link between key stakeholders — including Transportation Carriers, Hubs, and Warehouses — facilitating the flow of information and resolving issues that could impact customer experience or business continuity. The role spans two core verticals:
Inbound Operations – Manages the Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring freight is picked up on time and delivered to FCs as per scheduled appointments. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues arising during the pick-up to delivery lifecycle.
Outbound Operations – Manages the FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring trucks depart FCs on schedule to fulfill customer delivery promises. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues from the point freight leaves the FC through to last-mile delivery.
Trans Ops Representatives drive real-time resolutions by leveraging internal tools, querying relevant data, and making informed, time-sensitive decisions. The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of logistics operations, a sharp eye for data trends, and the ability to communicate effectively — both verbally and in writing.
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representatives are expected to proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive them to completion. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Serving as the communication bridge between external stakeholders (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal stakeholders (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
Systematically escalating issues or data variances to the appropriate owners and teams, and following through to ensure timely resolution
Preparing and presenting weekly narratives that outline key findings and variances against goals in review forums
Delivering real-time customer experience support within a 24×7 operating environment
- Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- 12–24 months of relevant work experience
- Strong communication skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to facilitate seamless information flow between external and internal stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
- Bachelor's degree with strong academic foundation
- Sound logical and analytical thinking skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple cross-functional teams

amazon-3134249.body:
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.
An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
About the team
Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.
- Bachelor's degree
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
About the team
Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.
- Bachelor's degree
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

amazon-10583409.body:
We are seeking a dedicated Base Building Maintenance Escalation Specialist to join our Amazon Maintenance Operations Centre (AMOC) team. This role is essential in providing 24/7 monitoring and response for our Amazon business unit, ensuring continuous operation through effective vendor management and technical support. The successful candidate will be responsible for first-line monitoring, vendor dispatch coordination, and escalation management across multiple Amazon business units.
Key job responsibilities
• Respond to and triage incoming work requests within standard service level agreements (SLAs).
• Manage remote works from start to end, including work order/purchase order raising and invoice processing.
• Communicate effectively and efficiently with stakeholders (Reliability Maintenance Engineering, Ops, H&S etc.).
• Provide updates on vendor status, take the lead on coordinating works during an escalation.
• Identify and escalate critical issues through appropriate channels to maintain equipment reliability and minimize operational impact.
• Monitor, respond to, and manage refrigeration alarm systems, ensuring timely response to critical alerts.
• Manage and prioritize work queues based on urgency and SLA requirements.
• Coordinate with local vendors and maintenance teams to ensure timely resolution of facility issues.
• Execute emergency response procedures during critical facility incidents.
• Document all actions and maintain accurate case records.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives for processes and procedures.
About the team
The Amazon Maintenance Operation Center International (AMOC INTL) is a 24/7/365 centralized function within Central RME, delivering remote maintenance services and support to field RME teams across all business types worldwide. Since launching in Q4 2019 with 24 European AGL/GSF sites, AMOC INTL has grown over 5 316%, now managing 1 300+ buildings across North America (1 099 sites), Europe (170 sites), APAC, LATAM, and AMET. Through centralized coordination and advanced monitoring, we ensure consistent, reliable maintenance operations—freeing field teams to focus on mission-critical RME projects.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience working with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
- Experience in root-cause problem solving
- Ability to work in a 24/7 shift environment
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities, or experience working with CMMS software

amazon-10602192.body:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Amazon is looking for self-driven, well organized professional to aid with the inventory and fiscal processes related to our Data Center Operations in India.The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
We are looking for someone to liaise with our suppliers and internal teams. Our ideal candidate is highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills.
You will be expected to manage Data Center public and confidential documentation and communication. Align with financial and inventory management teams. Respond to queries from internal and external Customers. You should have good understanding of financial processes, be expert with Microsoft Office and proficient with wide range of computer applications, such as Remedy, Wiki or Oracle Financial Applications. Ability to self-educate and achieve goals without external support is also important. We will expect you to document update and publish new processes.
Ideal candidate will be interested in computer technologies with a strong drive to learn new skills. Inventory Management experience is essential. You will be responsible for gathering data, generating, publishing and presenting metrics in variety of areas.
The base location for the candidate could be Mumbai or any other city and the candidate may be required to shift base.
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of transportation, shipping and receiving as well as inventory control, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on material handling equipment (i.e Pallet Jack).
 - Completing manual tasks, such as assembling, addressing and arranging for the shipment of materials, handling incoming shipments, unpack boxes and verify contents
 - Load and unload large equipment utilizing pallet jacks
 - Maintain accountability of in-stock components as well as receive and process inbound shipments
 - Assist with ongoing requests to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained and distributed to all locations to support build and repair activities
 - Working with the Logistics Manager, create plans to optimize the flow and delivery of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory locations and movement.
 - Working closely with Datacenter Operations Technicians to fulfill parts and equipment deliveries quickly and accurately
 - Working with Procurement teams to ensure that inbound equipment orders are complete and delivered to appropriate Data Center Locations.
 - Regular and ongoing communications with vendors to resolve issues and help them understand our business requirements necessitates a high-level communicator.
 - Support an environment that operates 24/7
 - Receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Data Center Technicians and Engineers
 - Load and unload shipments and transport parts, racks, and equipment between different locations, including localized driving of a variety of transportation vehicles
 - Handle sensitive/classified client materials
 - Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts
 - Occasionally work is in an office environment
A day in the life
A day in the life
- Position works in-person at a site location
 - Data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations
 - Maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and or excel spreadsheets and will create reports for internal and external customer and management as required.
 - Ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing
 - Assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials
 - Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations
 - Keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company
 - Frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
 - Regularly walk, use hands and f

amazon-10602226.title: Data Engineer, MIDAS, Digital Acceleration
amazon-10602226.summary:
Are you excited about the digital media revolution and passionate about designing and delivering advanced analytics that directly influence the product decisions of Amazon's digital businesses. Do you see yourself as a champion of innovating on behalf of the customer by turning data insights into action?
The Amazon Digital Acceleration (DA) org is looking for an analytical and technically skilled data engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing foundational analytical datasets spanning orders, subscriptions, discovery, promotions, pricing and royalties.
amazon-10602226.body:
Are you excited about the digital media revolution and passionate about designing and delivering advanced analytics that directly influence the product decisions of Amazon's digital businesses. Do you see yourself as a champion of innovating on behalf of the customer by turning data insights into action?
The Amazon Digital Acceleration (DA) org is looking for an analytical and technically skilled data engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing foundational analytical datasets spanning orders, subscriptions, discovery, promotions, pricing and royalties. Our mission is to enable digital clients to easily innovate with data on behalf of customers and make product and customer decisions faster. 
An ideal individual is someone who has deep data engineering skills around ETL, data modeling, database architecture and big data solutions. This individual should have strong business judgement, excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Key job responsibilities
1. Develop data products, infrastructure and data pipelines leveraging AWS services (such as Redshift, Kinesis, EMR, Lambda etc.) and internal BDT tools (Datanet, Cradle, QuickSight etc.
2. Improve existing solutions/build solutions to improve scale, quality, IMR efficiency, data availability, consistency & compliance.
3. Partner with Software Developers, Business Intelligence Engineers, MLEs, Scientists, and Product Managers to develop scalable and maintainable data pipelines on both structured and unstructured (text based) data.
4. Drive operational excellence strongly within the team and build automation and mechanisms to reduce operations
About the team
The MIDAS team operates within Amazon's Digital Analytics (DA) engineering organization, building analytics and data engineering solutions that support cross-digital teams. Our platform delivers a wide range of capabilities, including metadata discovery, data lineage, customer segmentation, compliance automation, AI-driven data access through generative AI and LLMs, and advanced data quality monitoring. Today, more than 100 Amazon business and technology teams rely on MIDAS, with over 20,000 monthly active users leveraging our mission-critical tools to drive data-driven decisions at Amazon scale.
- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.
